blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps. In practice the task vectors of different tasks interfere, and the standard remedies--averaging, magnitude pruning, sign election--operate entry by entry, ignoring that each delta induces a low-dimensional update on the hidden features it acts upon. We recast merging as a subspace interference problem. For every two-dimensional weight tensor we take the top-r right-singular subspace of each task's delta--the input directions along which that task moves the representation most--and remove from each task vector the component lying in the union of the other tasks' subspaces. The resulting Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP) is closed-form and order-independent, needs no forward pass, and is defined entirely by the checkpoint set. On eight CLIP image-classification tasks JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy without using a single image, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline (TIES-Merging, 77.57%), 14.22 above Task Arithmetic, and 0.98 above WUDI's data-free consensus merge (88.47%). The gain holds across three backbones on the independently trained TALL release (+10.8, +12.6, +9.1 over TIES for ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14) and replicates there at 89.20%; controls confirm the source--a single shared subspace instead of per-task ones loses 2.9 points, and a sequential variant collapses to 69.6%. On RoBERTa-large the same projection underperforms plain task arithmetic, which we report rather than hide. Code is available at https://github.com.
blocks.zh: 将独立的微调检查站合并为单一的多任务模式不需要数据、标签和梯度步骤。 在实践中,不同任务的任务矢量会干扰,标准补救-averaging,量冲,通过条目签名选举-操作输入,忽略了每个三角洲会诱导低维更新它所作用的隐藏特性. 我们把合并重编成亚空间干扰问题 对于每个二维的重角,我们取每个任务三角形的右上角的子空间—— 输入方向,该任务沿这个方向移动代表,从每个任务矢量中去除存在于其他任务子空间结合中的组件。 由此产生的联合Null-Space投影(JNSP)是封闭形式和命令独立的,不需要前进通道,完全由检查站设置来定义. 在八项CLIP图像分类任务上,JNSP将VIT-B/16专家合并到89.45 %的平均精度而不使用单一图像,11.88分高于最强参数无训练基线(TIES-Merging,77.57%),14.22分高于任务算术,0.98分高于WUDI的数据无数据共识合并(88.47%). 该增益在经过独立培训的TALL发布(+10.8,+12.6,+9.1比TIES为VIT-B/16,VIT-B/32,VIT-L/14)上占据了三个主干,并在那里复制89.20%;控制确认源-一个单一共享的子空间而不是每个任务共享的子空间损失2.9分,一个相继变体崩溃到69.6%. 在 RoBERTa 的宽度上,同样的投影效果不足 平面任务算术, 我们报告而不是隐藏。 代码可见于https://github.com.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : JNSP in three moves. (1) One pretrained CLIP encoder is fine-tuned once per task, so the experts share a coordinate system and need no alignment. (2) A task’s update inside a weight tensor concentrates on a few input directions (a cap); where caps overlap, tasks interfere, and entrywise rules cannot see it. JNSP projects each task off the union of the other tasks’ caps, keeping only directions no neighbour claims, symmetrically and in no fixed order. (3) The projected updates sum to one model serving every task, with no images, labels, gradients or optimisation.
blocks.zh: 图1:JNSP分三步走. (1)经过预选的CLIP编码器每任务一次进行微调,因此专家共享一个坐标系统,不需要对齐. (2)一个任务在加权计数器内部的更新集中在几个输入方向(一个上限);在盖子相重叠的情况下,任务干扰,进入规则无法看到. JNSP将每项任务从其他任务的总和中进行预测,只保留任何邻里要求的方向、对称和固定顺序。 (3)预测更新总和为每个任务服务的一个模型,没有图像,标签,梯度或优化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a foundation model once per task leaves checkpoints { 𝜽 1 , … , 𝜽 N } \{\bm{\theta}_{1},\dots,\bm{\theta}_{N}\} that descend from 𝜽 0 \bm{\theta}_{0} but serve different purposes, and serving them jointly costs N N copies plus input routing. Model merging synthesizes one parameter vector instead. The direct route adds the task vectors 𝝉 i = 𝜽 i − 𝜽 0 \bm{\tau}_{i}=\bm{\theta}_{i}-\bm{\theta}_{0} [ 23 , 48 , 32 ] , which degrades as N N grows because the updates conflict; existing remedies treat this interference entrywise—trimming and sign voting [ 50 ] , random dropping [ 53 ] , outlier sparsification [ 10 ] —or reweight the sum [ 52 , 9 , 17 , 6 , 39 ] (Appendix A ).

All of these assume interference is a property of individual parameters . Yet a task vector has structure: for a weight matrix 𝑾 ∈ ℝ m × n \bm{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} reading an n n -dimensional hidden state, the relevant geometry is the row space—which input directions the update amplifies [ 34 ] —and entrywise statistics cannot see it.
blocks.zh: 所有这些假设 干涉是个人参数的属性。 然而任务矢量有结构:对于一个重量矩阵 W QQ R × n\bm{W}\in\ mathbb{R}^{m\times n}读取了n -维隐藏状态,相关的几何是行空间——输入更新会放大 [34] ——并且条目统计无法看到.

blocks.en: We merge in the subspace where each task acts. Per tensor we take the top- r r right-singular subspace of 𝝉 i \bm{\tau}_{i} and define task i i ’s joint null space as the orthogonal complement of the union of the other tasks’ subspaces; projecting 𝝉 i \bm{\tau}_{i} onto it keeps what no neighbour claims and deletes what neighbours claim. Summing the projections gives Joint Null-Space Projection ( JNSP ): SVDs and QR factorizations only, no data, no gradients, no optimization, and order-invariant because every task is projected against the same neighbours. The subspace serves as a conflict map between tasks rather than a compression of each delta [ 17 ] (Section 3.4 ); Figure 1 summarizes it.
blocks.zh: 我们合并在每一个任务执行的子空间. 将任务i的连带空地定义为其他任务子空间结合的正统补充; 投射出\bm\taui} 将没有邻居要求的东西保留在它上, 并删除邻居要求的东西。 对预测进行总结后, SVD和QR因子化只存在,没有数据,没有梯度,没有优化,并且由于每个任务都是针对同一个相邻的相邻而预测的,因此顺序变化不一. 子空间是任务相冲突图,而不是压缩每个三角洲[17](第3.4节);图1总结了它.

blocks.en: On eight CLIP-based image-classification tasks, JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average top-1, against 77.57% for TIES-Merging and 75.23% for Task Arithmetic, and the lead holds on ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14 and an independently trained checkpoint release (89.20% versus 78.36%), without using a single image. It does not transfer to RoBERTa-large on GLUE, although language task-vector subspaces overlap about as much as the vision ones (mean squared overlap 0.142 0.142 versus 0.179 0.179 , both far above chance), so overlap alone does not explain the difference.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Model Soups averages checkpoints of one task [ 48 ] ; Task Arithmetic sums task vectors across tasks [ 23 ] and Fisher weighting reweights them [ 32 ] . Because these are coordinatewise, most subsequent work searches for the right entrywise filter: TIES trims to large magnitudes and elects signs by majority [ 50 ] , DARE drops a random fraction and rescales [ 53 ] , Model Breadcrumbs removes outlier and near-zero coordinates [ 10 ] . Each acts on coordinates independently and therefore commutes with any permutation of a row or column, which is exactly what discards the geometry we exploit.
blocks.zh: Model Soups平均一个任务的检查点[48];任务算术总和任务矢量跨越任务[23],而Fisher的权重重重取重取重取重取重取重取重取重取重取重取 [32]. 由于这些是协调的,所以大多数后续的工作搜索都是正确条目的过滤: TIES被裁为大尺度并按多数选出标志 [50], DARE会随机减少分数并调整比例 [53],Model Breadcrumbs去除出站和近零坐标 [10]. 每个坐标上都独立运行,因此与一行或一列的任何外接相通,这正是我们所利用的几何特征所抛弃的.

blocks.en: A second family learns the merge rather than designing it—per-layer coefficients from unlabeled-test entropy [ 52 ] , gradient or uncertainty matching [ 9 ] , evolutionary search [ 2 ] , distillation [ 45 ] —at the cost of an optimization loop and, typically, target data. A third works in singular space: TSV compresses each delta to its dominant singular vectors [ 17 ] , KnOTS aligns LoRA subspaces [ 43 ] , Tam et al . restrict the merge to a shared subspace [ 44 ] , SCORE builds one orthogonal basis from the union of the deltas [ 4 ] , Iso-C and Iso-CTS whiten a common subspace [ 31 ] , and TALL merges through task-vector geometry [ 47 ] . AlphaMerging [ 3 ] is closest: it projects each delta off the output-side (left) singular vectors of its peers, compressed to k k directions, whereas JNSP uses the input-side (right) vectors and keeps the union uncompressed—a conflict map rather than a compression. Projecting a task vector off its peers’ singular subspaces is therefore not new in itself (AlphaMerging here, NUFILT below); what we contribute is a specific construction—right-side bases, an uncompressed leave-one-out peer union, applied per tensor with no merge coefficient—and a controlled comparison against these operators on one checkpoint and evaluator. ESM argues that right singular vectors need not align with function [ 29 ] ; FDA instead reconstructs synthetic inputs from gradients [ 39 ] , initialized by WUDI to reduce interference [ 6 ] . Section 3.5 takes up ESM’s objection directly.
blocks.zh: 第二个家族学习合并而不是设计它——从无标签的测试entropy[52],梯度或不确定性匹配[9],进化搜索[2],分馏[45]——以优化循环和一般的目标数据为代价. 第三个作品在单相空间: TSV将每个三角洲压缩到其主单相向量 [17], KnOTS 将 LoRA 子相配 [43], Tam 等. 将合并限制在共享子空间 [44] , SCORE从三角洲 [4], Iso-C和 Iso-CTS 的结合上构建出一个正交基, 一个共同的子空间 [31], TALL通过任务矢量几何学合并 [47]. AlphaMerging [3] 最接近:它将每个三角洲从对等点的输出-侧(左)单向向量上预测,压缩到克方向,而JNSP则使用输入-侧(右)向量,并保持联盟不压缩——一个冲突图而不是压缩. 因此,从同行的单子空间中投射任务矢量本身并非新鲜事(AlphaMerging,下面是NUFILT);我们的贡献是:一个具体的构建 — — 右侧基础,一个未压缩的一离子对等联盟,按照没有合并系数的百分率使用,以及在一个检查站和评价员上与这些操作员进行有控制的比较。 无害环境管理认为,右单向量不一定与函数[29]一致;而是由WUDI初始化的梯度合成输入法重建出[39],以减少干扰[6]。 第3.5节直接述及无害环境管理的反对意见。

blocks.en: ZipIt [ 42 ] , Git Re-Basin [ 1 ] , and optimal-transport fusion [ 40 ] align neurons across independently initialized models [ 16 , 28 , 15 ] ; we share one initialization and handle the geometry of the deltas instead. Projecting updates off previously learned directions is standard in continual learning, notably Gradient Projection Memory [ 38 ] , and underlies memory-efficient adaptation [ 54 , 21 , 20 ] . NUFILT [ 35 ] applies the same operator, 𝑰 − 𝑽 ​ 𝑽 ⊤ \bm{I}-\bm{V}\bm{V}^{\top} , but accumulates the filtering basis along the merge order, so its result depends on that order; our leave-one-out construction applies it jointly, and Section 5.3 shows the difference is not cosmetic (18.4 points). Appendix A develops each family at length, and Figure 2 traces one test image through the operator.
blocks.zh: ZipIt [42], Git Re-Basin [1], 和最优的运输聚变 [40] 将神经元连接到独立初始化的模型中 [16, 28, 15]; 我们共享一个初始化并处理三角体的几何. 预测以往学习方向的更新是持续学习的标准,主要是渐变投影内存[38],也是内存高效改造的基础[54,21,20]. NUFILT [35] 应用相同的运算符,I-V \bm{I}-\bm{V}\bm{V}^{\top},但沿合并顺序累积过滤基础,因此其结果取决于该顺序;我们的一出局建设联合应用了它,而第5.3节显示区别不是化妆品(18.4分). 附 录 A以长度发展出每个家族,图2通过操作员追踪出一个测试图像.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Let 𝜽 0 ∈ ℝ d \bm{\theta}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} denote the pretrained weights and 𝜽 i \bm{\theta}_{i} the weights after fine-tuning on task i ∈ [ N ] ≡ { 1 , … , N } i\in[N]\equiv\{1,\dots,N\} . The task vector is 𝝉 i = 𝜽 i − 𝜽 0 \bm{\tau}_{i}=\bm{\theta}_{i}-\bm{\theta}_{0} , and Task Arithmetic merges with 𝜽 0 + λ ​ ∑ i 𝝉 i \bm{\theta}_{0}+\lambda\sum_{i}\bm{\tau}_{i} for a scaling coefficient λ \lambda [ 23 ] .

As in this literature, layer norms and biases stay at their pretrained values and each task keeps its own head; the merge applies to two-dimensional tensors whose smaller dimension is at least 64—the attention and MLP matrices plus five projection and embedding tensors (Appendix C ). For ViT-B/16 this is 53 tensors, and every baseline in § 4 uses the same subset.

blocks.en: Two tasks conflict when they claim the same directions. If 𝒙 \bm{x} has a substantial component in 𝒮 i ∩ 𝒮 j \mathcal{S}_{i}\cap\mathcal{S}_{j} , then ( Δ i + Δ j ) ​ 𝒙 (\Delta_{i}+\Delta_{j})\bm{x} carries two independent contributions along the same input direction; they may add—benign, if both tasks want the same change—or cancel, in which case the smaller is erased. blocks.en: Together these state what the method is: a symmetric, closed-form set of per-task least-squares projections that deletes whatever peers claim and keeps what only the task itself contributes. They are consistent with the two failure modes we observe—removing the consensus component and sequentializing—and identify r r as the knob trading retained signal against removed interference.
blocks.zh: 这些都说明了方法是什么: 一套对称的,闭合的每任务最小平方的预测,删除任何同行的主张,保留只有任务本身的贡献. 它们符合我们观察到的两种失败模式——放弃共识部分和顺序化——并认定r为knob交易所保留的反对被移除干扰的信号.

blocks.en: 3.5 What the Singular Basis Is Used For
blocks.zh: 3.5 (中文(简体) ). 星形基础用于什么

blocks.en: ESM [ 29 ] argues against right singular vectors as a merging basis: the singular value ordering of Δ i \Delta_{i} need not track functional importance, so a delta compressed to its own top- r r directions can discard a direction that matters to the task but carries little energy. We accept the premise, but it does not apply unchanged to ( 3 ), because our basis never compresses the delta it is computed from. 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} is never used to project Δ i \Delta_{i} —it is excluded from 𝑼 ∪ ( i ) \bm{U}^{(i)}_{\cup} and only enters the other tasks’ projectors—so the only thing deleted is Δ i \Delta_{i} ’s component inside other tasks’ top- r r spaces (which can include part of 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} ); a direction that is low-energy for task i i and not dominant for any neighbour is retained in full. The objection does survive in one place, and we state it rather than argue it away: a direction can be low- σ i \sigma_{i} , dominant for exactly one neighbour, and at the same time carry real function for task i i . Equations ( 1 )–( 3 ) cannot tell that case apart from a genuinely shared direction. Verified : the operator does not truncate Δ i \Delta_{i} to 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . Unverified : whether the deleted directions carry function for the task that loses them, and whether an activation-space basis of the kind ESM fits would select a better deletion set (Appendix K takes up both).
blocks.zh: EME [29] 反对右单向量作为合并基础: QQ i\Delta_{i}的单向值顺序不需要跟踪功能重要性,因此被压缩到自己上-r方向的三角洲可以丢弃对任务很重要但携带的能量很少的方向. 我们接受这一前提,但这一前提并不适用于(3),因为我们的基础从未对它所计算的三角洲进行压缩。 Si \ mathcal{S}_{i} 从未用于投影 i\ Delta_{i} – 它被排除在 U  (i)\bm{U}^{ (i)} 只进入其他任务投影器中 – 所以唯一被删除的是 i\ Delta_{i} 其它任务上- r 空格中的组件( 它可以包括 Si \ mathcal{S}_{i} 的一部分) ; 对于任务i 的低能而对于任何邻居 i 的主导方向被完整保留 。 这个反对确实存在于一个地方,我们说它,而不是说它去争论:一个方向可以是低-\\\sigma\i},对完全一个邻居来说是主力的,同时为任务i承担了真正的功能. 方程式(1)-(3)除了一个真正共同的方向外,不能说出这种情况。 已验证 : 操作员不将 QQ i\ Delta\\i} 切入 S i\ mathcal{ S\\i} 。 未验证 : 被删除的方向是否为丢失它们的任务承担了功能,以及类型无害环境管理的激活-空间基础是否适合选择一个更好的删除集(附录K同时承担这两个功能).

blocks.en: The same limitation applies to the meaning of overlap. JNSP treats a direction two tasks both move along as a conflict proxy , on the assumption that two tasks cannot both spend the same capacity. Overlap alone does not establish that the direction is contested rather than shared-beneficially. What the method measures is the geometric redundancy of the updates, not the sign of their interaction; Section 6 gives a case where this reading fails outright.
blocks.zh: 同样的限制也适用于重叠的含义。 JNSP将两个任务都当作冲突代用, 单靠重叠并不能确定方向有争议,而不是共同受益。 方法的衡量标准是更新的几何冗余,而不是其相互作用的标志; 第6节给出了一个这种读取完全失败的例子.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We follow the eight-task image-classification protocol now standard in model merging: MNIST [ 27 ] , EuroSAT [ 19 ] , GTSRB [ 41 ] , SVHN [ 33 ] , DTD [ 8 ] , RESISC45 [ 5 ] , Stanford Cars [ 26 ] , and SUN397 [ 49 ] . Each task starts from the same pretrained CLIP image encoder [ 36 , 7 ] and is fine-tuned end to end with its own head, giving N = 8 N{=}8 checkpoints per backbone (ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14 [ 12 ] ).
blocks.zh: 我们遵循目前模式合并中的八任务图像分类协议: MNIST [27], EuroSAT [19], GTSRB [41], SVHN [33], DTD [8], RESSC45 [5], Stanford Cars [26], SUN397 [49]. 每项任务都从同一预训的CLIP图像编码器起 [36, 7] 并被微调到自己的头来结束,给N=8个NQX8的每个主干站(Vit-B/16,Vit-B/32,Vit-L/14 [12]).

blocks.en: Because our ViT-B/16 checkpoints are our own, we repeat every experiment on the task vectors released by TALL [ 47 ] , produced by an independent pipeline with different fine-tuning recipes and heads.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的Vit-B/16检查站是属于我们自己的,我们重复TALL[47]释放的任务矢量的每一个试验,这些任务矢量是由一个独立的管道生产的,配有不同的微调配方和头.

blocks.en: We report top-1 accuracy with each task’s own head on the official test split. Merging applies to the 53 two-dimensional tensors with min ⁡ ( shape ) ≥ 64 \min(\text{shape})\geq 64 (Section 3.1 ); every method in Table 1 operates on this subset except WUDI, whose released operator merges 48 of the 53 and leaves five embedding and projection tensors at their pretrained values (Appendix Q ), so the comparison largely isolates the merge rule rather than the parameter scope.

blocks.en: Entrywise and consensus, data-free: Task Arithmetic [ 23 ] , TIES-Merging [ 50 ] , and DARE [ 53 ] , plus WUDI’s consensus subtraction [ 6 ] scored as a merge rule without adaptation. For each sweepable method we sweep the merge coefficient λ \lambda and report the best score, the setting most favourable to the baseline. Subspace-based (data-free): TSV-M [ 17 ] , Iso-C, Iso-CTS [ 31 ] , and AlphaMerging [ 3 ] , re-implemented in our harness (Section 4.3 ). All baselines in Table 1 are data-free. JNSP has no hyperparameter other than r r , fixed at 16 everywhere: it was chosen once on the ViT-B/16 rank sweep of these same eight tasks (Section 5.1 ) and never retuned.

Each column is one image; rows give the ground-truth label and the predictions of JNSP , TIES-Merging, and Task Arithmetic (blue: correct, red: incorrect). Samples are drawn at random from cases where JNSP is correct and both baselines err. The merge is entirely data-free in all three methods; only the merge rule differs. Per-image agreement counts are in Appendix L .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 is the central result. JNSP merges the eight ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy, 11.88 points above TIES-Merging (77.57%), the strongest of the parameter-wise baselines, and 14.22 points above Task Arithmetic (75.23%). It also leads the subspace family: TSV-M, AlphaMerging, Iso-C and Iso-CTS, re-implemented on the identical checkpoint and tensor scope, reach 87.22, 87.22, 87.15 and 86.59, so JNSP is 2.23–2.86 points ahead. Against WUDI’s consensus subtraction (88.47%) it leads by 0.98 points without tuning a threshold, a sign vote, or a drop rate.
blocks.zh: 表1是中心结果。 JNSP将8位Vit-B/16专家合并到89.4%的平均精度,比TIES-Merging(77.57%)高11.88分,是参数基准中最强的;比任务算术(75.23%)高14.22分. 它还领导了子空间家族:TSV-M,AlphaMerging,Iso-C和Iso-CTS,在相同的检查站和收音机范围上重新执行,达到87.22,87.22,87.15和86.59,因此JNSP领先了2.23–2.86分. 与WUDI的共识减值(88.47 %)相比,它领先了0.98分,没有调整门槛,没有标票,也没有下降率.

blocks.en: The per-dataset columns show where the margin comes from. TIES is competitive on MNIST (98.71) but degrades on visually diverse tasks (57.98 on DTD, 71.09 on Cars, 66.70 on SUN397); JNSP loses far less on exactly these (77.23, 84.25, 74.97), the signature one expects if the failure is interference between conflicting low-rank updates rather than accumulated magnitude. Against the subspace family the pattern differs: Iso-C and Iso-CTS are stronger on SUN397 (75.3–75.4) but fall below JNSP on SVHN (84.9–88.3 versus 92.16) and DTD. Appendix R decomposes both margins task by task; against the subspace family JNSP wins on five tasks and trails by at most 1.77. Figure 4 shows the margin on individual test images.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集栏显示比值来自何处. TIES在MNIST(98.71)上具有竞争力,但在视差多样的任务(DTD上57.98;Cars上71.09;SUN397上66.70);JNSP在这些任务(77.23、84.25、74.97)上的损失要少得多,人们预计,失败是否是相互冲突的低级更新之间的干扰,而不是累积数量。 相对于子空间家族,模式不同:Iso-C和Iso-CTS在SUN397(75.3–75.4)上更强,但在SVHN(84.9–88.3对92.16)和DTD上却低于JNSP. 附 录 R按任务分解了两个边际任务;而子空间家族JNSP最多以1.77分赢得了五个任务和小径. 图4显示单个测试图像的比值。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Scaling across backbones on the independently trained TALL release; every number is on that release, so cross-row comparisons are apples-to-apples. JNSP uses r = 16 r{=}16 throughout, untuned per backbone. † Re-implementation (Section 4.3 ). All methods are data-free and training-free.
blocks.zh: 表2:在独立训练的TALL发行版上跨出主干线;每个数字都在该发行版上,所以交叉比较是苹果对应用. JNSP全程使用r=16 r{=}16,每个骨干未调节. • 重新实施(第4.3节)。 所有方法都是无数据、无培训的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reproduction Gap for Published Subspace Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 已公布子空间基线的复制缺口

blocks.en: TSV-M reports 89.01 [ 17 ] and AlphaMerging 89.9 [ 3 ] on eight-task ViT-B/16; our re-implementations reach 87.22 for both. Every comparison here is on Avg , where all rows share one checkpoint, tensor scope and evaluator (Appendix S ).
blocks.zh: TSV-M报告 89.01 [17] 和 AlphaMerging 89.9 [3] 8个任务Vit-B/16;我们的再执行达到87.22 两者. 这里的每个比较都是在 Avg 上, 所有行都共享一个检查点, 热量范围和评价器(Appendix S.

blocks.en: All rows use one evaluation code, tensor scope, heads and test splits; the four subspace baselines were implemented from their published operators—top- r r task singular vectors with a per-task coefficient, a common subspace, its centred variant, and AlphaMerging’s peer-output projection followed by the WUDI solve—and swept over their free parameters. Re-running TSV-M, Iso-C and Iso-CTS on the TALL checkpoint moves them by at most 0.31 (87.25, 87.46, 86.62 against 87.22, 87.15, 86.59), so the checkpoint is not the missing variable for these three. AlphaMerging was run on TALL at its best own-checkpoint setting ( r 1 = 32 r_{1}{=}32 , k = 64 k{=}64 ) without re-sweeping and drops to 85.40 (87.22 at the same setting on our checkpoint), so for it the setting does not transfer unchanged. We therefore claim a 2.23–2.86 point lead under a protocol we control end to end.
blocks.zh: 所有行都使用一个评价代码、收音机范围、头和测试分;四个子空间基线是从其公布的操作员——具有每个任务系数的顶-r任务单向量、一个共同子空间、其中心变体和AlphaMerging的对等输出预测以及WUDI解决方案之后的对等输出预测——执行的,并覆盖了它们的自由参数。 在TALL检查站上重新运行TSV-M,Iso-C和Iso-CTS最多移动了0.31(87.25,87.46,86.62对87.22,87.15,86.59),因此检查站不是这3个的缺失变量. AlphaMerging在TALL上运行时,在自己的最佳检查点设置(r 1 = 32 r r = 1}{=}32,k = 64 k{=}64)上没有再扫射并下降至85.40(在我们检查站的同一设置下为87.22),因此设置没有不变地转移. 因此,我们要求根据一项我们控制的最后结束的议定书提供2.23-2.86点的线索。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the TALL release. On ViT-B/16, JNSP reaches 89.20% against 78.36% for TIES, a 10.84-point lead (11.88 on our own checkpoints): the effect is a property of independently fine-tuned CLIP experts, not of one set of hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表2汇报了TALL的发布情况. 在Vit-B/16上,JNSP达到89.20%,而TIES则达到78.36%,这是10.84分的领先点(我们自己的检查站为11.88分):效果是独立微调的CLIP专家的财产,而不是一套超参数。

blocks.en: 4.4 Backbone Scaling
blocks.zh: 4.4 后骨缩放

blocks.en: The gain does not depend on model size. On ViT-B/32 JNSP reaches 82.92% versus 70.31% for TIES (+12.61) and 81.09% for TSV-M, the best subspace baseline there (+1.83); on ViT-L/14, 90.87% versus 81.73% for TIES (+9.14) and 89.42% for AlphaMerging (+1.45). The best subspace baseline changes across backbones (Iso-C on B/16, TSV-M on B/32, AlphaMerging on L/14), but JNSP places first at every backbone. The margin over the subspace family (1.45–1.83) is much narrower than over TIES, and narrowest on the largest model.
blocks.zh: 增益并不取决于模型大小. 在Vit-B/32 JNSP上,TIES(+12.61)达到82.92%,TSV-M达到70.31%;TSV-M达到81.09%,是那里最好的亚空间基线(+1.83);在Vit-L/14上,TIES(+9.14)达到90.87%,而TIES(+9.14)达到81.73%;AlphaMering(+1.45)达到89.42%。 最佳子空间基线跨骨干的变化(Iso-C on B/16,TSV-M on B/32,AlphaMerging on L/14),但JNSP在每一个骨干中位居第一. 亚空间家族的比值(1.45–1.83)要小得多,在最大的模型上最窄.

blocks.en: 4.5 Statistical Precision
blocks.zh: 4.5 统计精确度

blocks.en: JNSP is deterministic: for fixed checkpoints and r r the merge is closed-form, so seed variance is identically zero. We report instead a stratified bootstrap over the evaluation set [ 14 ] : in each of 2,000 replicates, every task’s test set is resampled with replacement independently at its original size, the eight task accuracies are recomputed and averaged with equal weight, and the 95% interval is the 2.5th–97.5th percentile of the resulting macro-averages; point estimates are the observed (non-resampled) accuracies. This gives 89.45 % 89.45\% [ 89.17 , 89.75 ] [89.17,89.75] on our checkpoints and 89.20 % 89.20\% [ 88.90 , 89.51 ] [88.90,89.51] on TALL. The interval measures uncertainty in the evaluation , not in training; it is narrow because the test sets are large (87,432 images in total).
blocks.zh: JNSP是决定性的:对于固定的检查站和rr的合并是封闭式的,所以种子差异完全为零. 相反,我们报告在评价套 [14] 上有一个分级的靴子:在2,000个复制品中,每个任务测试套件都按原尺寸独立地被重置,8个任务重置,平均重置,95%的间隔是所得出的宏观平均值的2.5-97.5分之;点估计值是观察到的(非重置)重置。 这使我们的检查站占89.4% [89.17,89.75] [89.17,89.75],TALL占89.20% [88.90,89.51][88.90,89.51]。 间隔测量评价中的不确定性,而不是培训中的不确定性;由于测试集很大(总共87,432个图像),所以间隔很窄.

blocks.en: 5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5 损坏

blocks.en: The main table answers whether JNSP works; this section asks why, using the ViT-B/16 checkpoints and the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 主要表格回答JNSP是否有效;本节询问为什么使用Vit-B/16检查站和同一协议.

blocks.en: 5.1 Rank
blocks.zh: 5.1 军衔

blocks.en: The rank r r is the only hyperparameter. Figure 5 (Appendix E ) sweeps it from 8 to 32 together with the shared-basis control: 88.03% at r = 8 r{=}8 , a peak of 89.45% at r = 16 r{=}16 , 89.22% at r = 20 r{=}20 , and 87.08% at r = 32 r{=}32 . The [ 12 , 20 ] [12,20] plateau is flat—its endpoints differ by 0.08 points—and r = 16 r{=}16 is chosen once, never retuned per backbone or dataset.
blocks.zh: r级是唯一的超参数。 图5(附录E)将其从8至32并连同共享基础控制:88.03%为r=8 r{=}8,峰值为:89.4%为r=16 r{=}16,89.22%为r=20 r{=}20,87.08%为r=32 r{=}32. [12, 20] [12, 20] 高地为平地-它的终点相差0.08分- r = 16 r = 16 r = 16 被选中一次,从未对每个主干线或数据集进行再调整.

blocks.en: The two tails behave differently. At r = 32 r{=}32 the neighbours’ union covers much of each delta (26.0% of the aggregate norm survives) and accuracy falls by 2.37 points. At r = 8 r{=}8 the aggregate retained ratio is higher (33.4%), yet accuracy is 1.42 points lower than at r = 16 r{=}16 ; retained norm alone therefore does not explain the low-rank tail, and a plausible reading—not tested here—is that an 8-dimensional peer basis misses interfering directions that a 16-dimensional one removes. The sweep extends to ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 on the TALL checkpoints (Table 9 , Appendix E ): the plateau shape is stable and accuracy peaks at or within 0.01 points of r = 16 r{=}16 everywhere.
blocks.zh: 两条尾巴行为不一. 在r = 32 r{=}32时,邻国联盟覆盖了每个三角洲的大部分地区(总标准存活了26.0%),准确度下降了2.37分。 在r = 8 r{=}8 时,总保留率较高(33.4%),但准确度比r = 16 r{=}16 时低1.42分;因此,仅保留规范并不能解释低等尾巴,而且一个合理的读取(此处没有测试)是8维的同位素基础忽略了16维一去掉的干扰方向。 扫荡延伸到TALL检查站上的VIT-B/32和VIT-L/14(表9,附录E):高地形状平稳,准确度峰值为0.01分(r=16 r{=}16)以内或以内.

blocks.en: 5.2 Mechanism Control: Shared versus Per-Task Subspace
blocks.zh: 5.2 机制控制: 共享对任务子空间

blocks.en: The claim of Section 3 is that the gain comes from using each task’s subspace to predict where another task interferes. A simpler alternative computes one shared subspace—the top- r r right singular vectors of the sum of all deltas—and projects every task against it, which equals projecting the summed delta once. That removes the direction all tasks share [ 23 , 34 ] but has no notion of which task conflicts with which. It loses 2.94 points at r = 16 r{=}16 (86.51 versus 89.45) and 2.14–3.15 at every rank. At 86.51% it still beats the entrywise baselines (TIES 77.57%) but trails WUDI and the subspace re-implementations (86.59–88.47%), so shared-direction removal is not useless: it recovers about three quarters of JNSP ’s margin over TIES (8.94 of 11.88 points). The remainder is consistent with pairwise structure mattering—task j j ’s dominant directions being specifically the ones task i i must avoid—though this control does not isolate that explanation.
blocks.zh: 第3节的说法是,收益来自利用每个任务的子空间来预测另一个任务在哪里干扰. 一个更简单的替代计算一个共享的子空间——所有三角洲的总和的上-r 右单向量——并预测每一项任务,这等于一次对三角洲的总和进行预测。 这就排除了所有任务共有的方向[23,34],但并不知道哪些任务与哪些任务相冲突。 它在r = 16 r = 16 (86.51对 89.45)和2.14–3.15的每个军衔上损失2.94分. 在86.51%时,它仍然比入门基线(TIES 77.57%)好,但跟踪WUDI和子空间再实施(86.59–88.47 % ) , 因此共享方向去除并非无济于事:它回收了约四分之三的JNSP比TIES差值(11.88分之8.94 ) 。 其余部分与双向结构问题一致 -- -- 任务jj的主要方向是我必须避免的任务 -- -- 尽管这种控制并不孤立这种解释。

blocks.en: 5.3 Order Dependence
blocks.zh: 5.3 依赖性

blocks.en: Continual-learning practice suggests merging tasks one at a time, projecting each against the basis accumulated so far. The sequential analysis of Section 3.4 predicts that this is order-dependent and progressively destructive, and the measurement is unambiguous: at matched rank r = 8 r{=}8 the sequential variant scores 69.64% against 88.03% for the joint variant, a collapse of 18.4 points. The per-dataset pattern (Figure 6 , Appendix H ) is consistent with that prediction: early tasks survive nearly intact (MNIST 99.59%, EuroSAT 93.81%), while later ones are gutted—RESISC45 64.78%, Cars 51.14%, SUN397 36.14%. The sequential variant also retains more aggregate norm (35.90% versus 33.44%), so the amount deleted does not explain the collapse. Each task loses only its overlap with earlier tasks, and early tasks are never filtered against later ones, so their overlap with later tasks enters the sum unprojected. The joint form avoids this asymmetry by construction: every task is projected against the same seven neighbours, so the merge is order-invariant (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 继续学习的做法建议一次合并一项任务,按照迄今积累的基础预测每项任务。 第3.4节的相继分析预测,这是依序进行的,并逐渐具有破坏性,测量是毫不含糊的:在相匹配的等级 r = 8 r{=} 8 时,相继变体得分69.64%,而联合变体得分为88.03%,倒数为18.4分. 每个数据集的模式(图6,附录H)与这一预测一致:早期任务几乎完好无损(MNIST 99.59%,EuroSAT 93.81%),而后期任务被切断——RESISC45 64.78%,汽车 51.14%,SUN397 36.14%。 相继变体也保留了更相加的集合规范(35.90%对33.44%),因此被删除的金额并不能解释崩溃的原因. 每个任务只失去与更早的任务的重叠,早期的任务从不被后期的任务过滤出,因此它们与后期任务的重叠输入未预测的总和. 联合形式通过建筑避免了这种不对称:每个任务都是针对同一个七个邻国预测的,所以合并是顺序-变化(第3.4节.

blocks.en: 6 Where the Method Fails: Language Models
blocks.zh: 6个 方法失败之处:语言模式

blocks.en: We test a second architecture family. The result is negative, and it bounds what JNSP can claim.
blocks.zh: 我们测试第二个建筑家族。 结果是负面的,它限制了JNSP可以声称的东西.

blocks.en: We merge eight RoBERTa-large [ 30 ] checkpoints fine-tuned on GLUE [ 46 ] from one pretrained checkpoint, with the same r r and projection as in vision and the same min ⁡ ( shape ) ≥ 64 \min(\text{shape})\geq 64 filter, which here selects 146 tensors (the 144 attention and FFN matrices plus the word and position embeddings). Task arithmetic at its usual scaling λ = 0.2 \lambda{=}0.2 reaches 59.70 and the shared-basis control 63.28; JNSP , which has no merge coefficient ( λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 ), reaches 31.43. It degrades most tasks, STS-B collapses to a negative score, and every diagnostic that explains the vision result inverts. Part of this gap is a scaling effect: unlike in vision, the unscaled sum is far from optimal on GLUE (task arithmetic at λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 scores 39.76, Appendix T ), so the comparison above mixes two scalings.
blocks.zh: 我们合并了8个在GLUE上经过微调的RBERTA大[30]检查站,从一个经过预先训练的检查站取出相同的r和投影(形状)-------------(\text{shape})--------------------64过滤器,在此选择146个分数(144个注意和FFN矩阵加上字和位置嵌入)。 任务算术按通常的缩放 = 0.2\lambda\0.2 达到59.70,共享基数控制 63.28;没有合并系数的 JNSP (= = 1\lambda\1),达到31.43. 它使大多数任务退化,STS-B倒闭为负分,每个诊断解释视觉结果倒转. 这一差距的一部分是缩放效果:与视觉不同,未缩放的总和在GLUE上远非最优(任务算法:QQ=1\lambda{=}1分 39.76分,附录T),因此上面的比较混合了两个缩放.

blocks.en: Language task vectors do not overlap more: at r = 16 r{=}16 the mean squared overlap is 0.142 0.142 for RoBERTa-large ( 9.0 × 9.0\times its random baseline of 0.0157 0.0157 ) against 0.179 0.179 for ViT-B/16, marginally lower .

blocks.en: In vision the joint merge retains 30.4% of the delta norm and improves accuracy; in language it retains 42.7%— more mass—and yet destroys the merge. Projecting deletes less and hurts more. One untested reading is that in the language encoder the removed directions carry structure every task needs; our experiments cannot separate this from differences in architecture, objective, tokenization or scaling. A consensus–residual decomposition that projects the task-specific residual instead recovers 69.45%, 6.17 points above the global control (Appendix T ); we report it as a repair, not a contribution.
blocks.zh: 在愿景中,联合合并保留了30.4%的三角洲规范,并提高了准确性;在语言中,联合合并保留了42.7%的质量,但却摧毁了合并。 投影删除少而伤害多. 一个未经测试的读取是,在语言编码器中,被删除的方向承载着每个任务需要的结构;我们的实验不能将它与架构,目标,标注或缩放的不同区分开来. 一项共识 — — 剩余分解,即预测特定任务残留的回收率为69.45 % , 高于全球控制(附录T ) ; 我们把它报告为修复而不是贡献。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We cast model merging as subspace interference and proposed Joint Null-Space Projection, which removes from each task vector its components in the other tasks’ dominant-update directions. It is closed-form and data-free, has one hyperparameter, and is flat over a wide rank range. On eight image-classification tasks it merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45%, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline and 0.98 above WUDI’s consensus merge, a lead that survives three backbones and an independent checkpoint release. Generative objectives are untested, and the language failure is diagnosed but not explained.
blocks.zh: 我们将模型合并为子空间干扰,并提议联合Null-Space投影,从每个任务矢量中删除其他任务的主要更新方向的组件。 其为封闭式并不含数据,有1个超参数,平地范围为宽等. 在8个图像分类任务中,Vit-B/16专家合并到89.45 %,比最强参数无培训基线高11.88分,比WUDI共识合并高0.98分,这是在三个骨干和独立的检查站释放中存活下来的领先点。 基因目标未经测试,语言故障被诊断出来但没有解释.

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩展的相关工作

blocks.en: This appendix expands Section 2 (see [ 51 ] for a broader survey) and states, family by family, which precise operation each baseline performs on a task vector and where JNSP departs from it.
blocks.zh: 本附录扩展了第2节(关于更广泛的调查,见[51]),并逐个家庭说明每个基线在任务矢量上的具体操作情况以及JNSP偏离任务矢量的地方。

blocks.en: Model Soups [ 48 ] averages checkpoints fine-tuned from one initialization on the same task and shows that the average is more robust than any member. Task Arithmetic [ 23 ] turns the averaging into a merge primitive for different tasks: with 𝝉 i = 𝜽 i − 𝜽 0 \bm{\tau}_{i}=\bm{\theta}_{i}-\bm{\theta}_{0} it proposes 𝜽 0 + λ ​ ∑ i 𝝉 i \bm{\theta}_{0}+\lambda\sum_{i}\bm{\tau}_{i} and demonstrates that a single scalar λ \lambda controls the tradeoff between task performance and general capability; the earlier PAINT [ 22 ] interpolates a fine-tuned and a zero-shot CLIP model for the same purpose. Fisher-weighted merging [ 32 ] replaces the uniform average by a diagonal-Fisher weighting, which requires an estimate of the Fisher information per task. All three treat the sum coordinate by coordinate and have no mechanism for deciding that two coordinates belong to different tasks; the failure is visible in Table 1 as the collapse on DTD and SUN397.
blocks.zh: Model Soups [48] 平均对检查站进行微调,从一个在同一任务上初始化,并显示平均比任何成员都强。 任务 Arithmetic [23] 将平均值变成不同任务的合并原始: 有\\\ i =\\ \ \ \ \ \ \ 我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~它提议~我~我~我~我~我~我~我~ 并且证明一个Scalar \\ lambda控制任务性能和一般能力之间的取舍; 早期的PAINT [22] 插入一个微调和零发CLIP模型,用于同样的目的。 渔业加权合并[32]用对角-Fisher加权法取代了统一平均值,这就需要估计每项任务的渔业信息. 三者都通过坐标处理总和坐标,没有确定两个坐标属于不同任务的机制;失败在表1中可见为DTD和SUN397上的崩溃.

blocks.en: TIES-Merging [ 50 ] applies three successive operations per tensor: trim each delta to its largest- k k magnitudes, elect a sign per coordinate by summing the signed normalized values, and average only the coordinates whose sign agrees with the election. DARE [ 53 ] zeroes a fraction p p of coordinates at random and rescales the survivors by 1 / ( 1 − p ) 1/(1-p) , motivated by the observation that deltas are highly redundant. Model Breadcrumbs [ 10 ] masks both the largest and the smallest entries. Each acts on entries independently, so it commutes with any permutation of the entries of a tensor and is therefore blind to whether two deltas with identical entry statistics act on the same or on orthogonal input directions. Section D reports the coefficient sweeps used to give these methods their best shot.
blocks.zh: TIES-Merging [50] 每百分位数连续应用三次操作:将每个三角地标调整到最大-k克等分,通过对所签名的正态值进行相接来选择每个坐标的标志,并平均只选择其标志与选举一致的坐标. DARE [53] 随机地将坐标的分数p零出一分之p,再以 1 / (1-p) 1/ (1-p) 来重新标出幸存者,其动机是观察三角洲是非常多余的. 型面包屑 [10] 口罩既最大也最小的条目. 每个条目都独立行事,因此它与一个变位器条目的任何通缩,因此对两个具有相同条目统计的三角洲是在同一输入方向上还是正交输入方向上行事视而不见. 节次 D报告了用于给这些方法提供最佳机会的系数扫描。

blocks.en: AdaMerging [ 52 ] optimizes per-layer merge coefficients to minimize prediction entropy on unlabeled test data; its entropy objective needs a forward pass over target data at every step. Uncertainty-based gradient matching [ 9 ] derives per-task weights from gradient statistics; evolutionary search [ 2 ] and distillation-based merging [ 45 ] go further in the same data-dependent direction. These methods trade the closed form for adaptivity. WUDI [ 6 ] can also be read as a merge rule in its own right: its consensus subtraction, applied once and scored without adaptation, reaches 88.47% (Table 1 ), and the same construction serves as the initialization for the FDA adaptation we compare against at 88.90%.
blocks.zh: AdaMerging [52] 优化了每层合并系数,以将无标签测试数据的预测entropy最小化;其entropy目标每一步都需要一个前传目标数据. 基于不确定性的梯度匹配[9]从梯度统计中得出每个任务的权重;以演化搜索[2]和以蒸馏为主的合并[45]在同一个数据依赖方向上更进一步. 这些方法用封闭形式换取适应性。 WUDI [6] 本身也可以被理解为一种合并规则:它的共识减值,一次适用,不经过调整而得分,达到88.47%(表1),同样的构思作为FDA适应的初始化,与88.90%相比.

blocks.en: TSV [ 17 ] decomposes each task delta by SVD and keeps only the dominant singular vectors, then decorrelates the concatenated per-task singular vectors across tasks before reconstructing the merge; the subspace is used to compress and to whiten . KnOTS [ 43 ] aligns LoRA adapters across tasks so that a single low-rank basis can represent them. Matching-models-in-task-subspaces [ 44 ] restricts the merge to a shared task subspace. JNSP uses the same decomposition but a different role for it: the top- r r right-singular subspace of task j j is not used to compress 𝝉 j \bm{\tau}_{j} but to predict which directions of task i i will be corrupted, and only the overlap is removed. The shared-basis control in Section 5.2 , which replaces the per-task peer unions by one common basis, loses 2.94 points.
blocks.zh: TSV [17] 由 SVD 分解出每个任务三角洲, 并且只保留占优势的单向量, 然后在重建合并之前将每个任务单向量对接; 子空间用于压缩并白化 。 KnOTS [43] 使LORA适配器在任务之间保持一致,以便一个低等的基础能够代表它们. 匹配-模型-在任务-子空间 [44] 将合并限制在一个共享的任务子空间. JNSP使用相同的分解但作用不同:任务j j的上- r 右- singular子空间不用于压缩\ j\ bm\ tau\ j} 而是用来预测任务 I 的哪些方向会被损坏, 只有重叠被去除. 第5.2节中的共享基础控制以一个共同基础取代每个任务同行联盟,损失了2.94分.

blocks.en: ZipIt [ 42 ] , Git Re-Basin [ 1 ] , and optimal-transport fusion [ 40 ] align hidden units before merging, exploiting symmetries of the loss surface documented by [ 15 , 16 , 28 ] . This line addresses merging of independently initialized networks. Our tasks share one initialization, so there is nothing to align; the structure that survives is the task-specific geometry of the deltas.
blocks.zh: ZipIt [42], Git Re-Basin [1], 和最佳-运输聚变 [40] 在合并前对齐隐藏单元, 利用 [15, 16, 28] 所记录的损失表面的对称性. 本行涉及独立初始化网络的合并. 我们的任务共享一个初始化,所以没有什么可以对齐的;活下来的结构是三角洲的任务特有几何.

blocks.en: Gradient Projection Memory [ 38 ] stores the input subspace of previously learned tasks and projects new gradients orthogonal to it, which is exactly the sequential construction we analyse and reject in Section 5.3 . Low-rank projection also underpins memory-efficient training [ 54 ] and parameter-efficient adaptation [ 21 , 20 ] . The tangent-space analysis of [ 34 ] shows that merged behaviour is a first-order sum of each task’s functional perturbation; because that perturbation is largest along the input-side singular directions, projecting on the input side removes the strongest cross-task contributions first.
blocks.zh: 渐变投影内存 [38] 存储了以前学到的任务的输入子空间,并且将新的正向梯度投影,这正是我们在第5.3节中分析和拒绝的相继构造. 低排名的预测也支撑了内存高效培训[54]和参数高效适应[21,20]. [34]的切入-空间分析显示,合并行为是每个任务功能扰动的一阶总和;因为扰动沿着输入-侧单数方向最大,投影在输入侧会先去掉最强的跨任务贡献.

blocks.en: The reason a sum of task vectors can be expected to behave like a model trained on all tasks is that fine-tuning moves the model along a locally linear path. Ortiz-Jimenez et al. [34] make this precise: to first order, the functional change induced by an update Δ \Delta is ℱ ⁡ ( 𝜽 0 + Δ ) − ℱ ⁡ ( 𝜽 0 ) ≈ J Δ ​ ℱ 0 \mathcal{F}(\bm{\theta}_{0}+\Delta)-\mathcal{F}(\bm{\theta}_{0})\approx J_{\Delta}\mathcal{F}_{0} , and the task vectors of individually fine-tuned models therefore compose as a sum of functional perturbations. Two consequences matter for this paper. First, the approximation is first-order, so it degrades exactly where the perturbations are large, which is the regime of genuinely different tasks rather than different runs on the same task. Second, the size of Δ \Delta ’s functional effect is measured in the input-side geometry, because an update W ↦ W + Δ W\mapsto W+\Delta changes the layer’s output on input x x by Δ ​ x \Delta x ; the directions of x x on which Δ \Delta has large gain are precisely its leading right-singular directions. This is why averaging task vectors entrywise is only a proxy for averaging their functions: two deltas can have the same entry statistics and non-overlapping input geometry, in which case the average is a faithful superposition of their functions, or identical input geometry, in which case it is a crude cancellation of them. JNSP acts on the quantity the linearization view names, by removing each delta’s component in the directions its neighbours already occupy.
blocks.zh: 可以期望任务矢量的总和表现得像一个在所有任务上受过训练的模型,其原因是将模型微调地沿着局部线性路径移动. Ortiz-Jimenez 等 [34] 作此精确:第一顺序,由 \\ Delta 更新引发的功能变化是 F\\ ( + + + + + + + + + + + → F\ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + 本文有两个后果很重要。 第一,相近是一等相,因此它完全在扰动较大的地方降解,这是真正不同任务而不是不同任务运行在同一任务上的制度. 第二,\德尔塔的功能效应大小在输入侧几何中被测量出,因为更新W + + + + W\mapsto W + Delta 在输入x上以 + + + Delta x 修改了层的输出;xx的取向是它最主要的右向. 正因为如此,平均任务向量在条目上仅是平均函数的代名词: 两个三角洲可以有相同的条目统计和不相重叠的输入几何,在这种情况下,平均值是对其函数的忠实叠加,或者完全相同的输入几何,在这种情况下是粗略地取消它们. blocks.en: We use task-private as a defined term, not a claim about semantics. Task i i ’s own subspace 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} is the span of the top- r r right-singular vectors of Δ i \Delta_{i} (the uncentred analogue of the leading principal directions of its rows [ 24 ] ), and a direction is called task-private for i i when it lies in that span and is orthogonal to every 𝒮 j \mathcal{S}_{j} , j ≠ i j\neq i ; only such directions are guaranteed to survive the projection (Proposition 1 ). This is a statement about the update matrix, computable from the checkpoints alone, and it is deliberately not a claim that the direction is used only by the task’s images in an interpretable sense. Appendix F measures how much of each delta lies in its peers’ union: at r = 16 r{=}16 , 61.0% of a task’s delta norm on average (about 37% of its energy), and at R = 64 R{=}64 the peer-union and own-basis fractions are numerically equal (85.1% versus 85.2%). Alternative operational definitions are possible, and which one is right is an empirical question we cannot settle here. A gradient-based definition would take the subspace spanned by per-example gradients, the object used by Gradient Projection Memory [ 38 ] and elastic weight consolidation [ 25 ] ; that is closer to what matters functionally, but it needs forward and backward passes over task data and therefore forfeits data-freedom. A second-order definition would use the diagonal Fisher, which is what Fisher merging [ 32 ] weights by, and which also requires data. Our choice is the one available at merge time from checkpoints alone.
blocks.zh: 我们用私人任务作为定义的术语,而不是对语义的主张. 任务一本身的子空间 S i\ mathcal{S}_{i} 是上- r 右 single 向量的跨度 {i i\ Delta_{i} (其行主要方向的无中心模拟 [24] ), 当方向位于该跨度中, 并且对每个 S j\ mathcal{S}_{j}, j≠ i\ j\neq i i i 的正向, 只有这样的方向才能保证能活过投影( 第 1 提案) 。 这是关于更新矩阵的说明,仅从检查站即可计算,故意不声称该方向仅由任务图像在可解释的意义上使用。 附录F衡量每个三角洲在同伴联盟中所占的比例:在r = 16 r = 16,平均占任务三角洲规范的61.0%(约占其能量的37%),在R = 64 R = 64,同伴联盟和自基分数在数字上相等(85.1%对85.2%)。 备选的业务定义是可能的,哪一个是正确的一个经验问题,我们不能在这里解决。 基于梯度的定义将取出由每个实例梯度所跨越的子空间,渐变投影内存[38]和弹性重力合并[25]所使用的对象;这更接近功能上重要的事物,但它需要向前和后向传递任务数据,从而失去数据自由. 第二顺序定义将使用对角法Fisher,这是Fisher将[32]权重合并起来的方法,同时也需要数据. 我们的选择是在合并时仅由检查站提供。

blocks.en: Removing energy from a weight matrix is what pruning does, and one could describe JNSP as a structured, input-side pruning of task vectors in which the pruned set is chosen adversarially by the other tasks rather than by magnitude. The two differ in a way that matters for the failure modes. Magnitude pruning assumes small entries are unimportant; the empirical failure of that assumption when a network is fine-tuned is well documented and motivates the sparse fine-tuning literature. Our per-tensor retention data (Appendix I ) show the same assumption failing in the singular-value domain: at r = 32 r{=}32 the merge keeps only 26.0% of the aggregate norm and scores 2.37 points below r = 16 r{=}16 , so components that a magnitude-style criterion would call expendable can matter; whether the removed components carry task function is not established by this measurement. The projection is also related to the low-rank reparameterizations used in parameter-efficient adaptation [ 21 , 20 ] : both work in the input-side subspace of W W . The difference is that LoRA adds a low-rank term to a frozen matrix and learns it from data, whereas JNSP removes a low-rank term from a fine-tuned delta without data and without training.
blocks.zh: 从权重矩阵中去除能量是普鲁因的作用,人们可以将JNSP描述为对任务矢量的一种结构化的,输入侧式的普鲁因集合被其他任务而不是数量选择为对抗性的任务矢量. 两者不同,对失败模式很重要。 粗略的修饰假设小条目并不重要;网络微调时这种假设的经验性失败是有充分记载的,并激励了稀少的微调文献. 我们的每等分保留数据(Appendix I)显示在单值域中失败的假设相同: 在 r = 32 r {=} 32 时,合并只保留了总规范的26.0%,在 r = 16 r{=}16 下得分2.37分,因此一个量级标准称消耗性的标准的组件可以有关系;被移除的组件是否包含任务函数不是通过这个测量确定的. 投影也与参数高效适应[21,20]中使用的低级再参数化有关:WW输入-侧子空间的两种工作. 不同之处在于,LORA在被冻结的矩阵中添加了低等名词,并从数据中学习,而JNSP则在没有数据也没有培训的情况下从微调的三角地中去掉了低等名词.

blocks.en: Methods that adapt at inference—entropy minimization over merged weights [ 52 ] , or the unlabeled-data adaptation in TALL [ 47 ] —are complementary to this work rather than alternatives: they change the merged model after the merge, whereas JNSP changes which components of each task vector enter the merge. Combining the two is not automatic, and the outcome depends on what the adaptation is allowed to see. Adapting a merged model on synthetic anchors does not reach the data-free operator in our runs: FDA started from the pretrained weights scores 86.93%, and the best variant, started from WUDI’s 88.47% merge, reaches 88.90% (Table 26 ), still below the 89.45% of the JNSP merge itself. In our runs synthetic-anchor adaptation therefore did not surpass the JNSP merge, and we make no broader claim about it. Supplying a small number of real samples is different: distilling the eight experts into the JNSP merge with 256 real training images per task raises it from 89.45% to 91.17% (Appendix Q ). The contrast is the one the rest of the paper draws in other terms: the merge decides which update each task contributes, and only a supervised signal carries information the merge does not already have. The relationship to continual learning is closer and more cautionary. Sequential projection is the core mechanism of several continual-learning methods [ 38 , 37 , 25 ] , and Section 5.3 shows it collapsing to 69.64% in the merge setting. The difference is the objective: continual learning accepts order dependence because it wants the newest task to survive, whereas a merge is supposed to be symmetric in the task list. Reusing the machinery without its objective produces the worst of both—each task is progressively blinded, and no task is preferentially protected.
blocks.zh: 推想中适应的方法——在合并加权数[52]或TALL[47]中的无标签数据调整——是对这项工作的补充,而不是替代方法:在合并后改变合并模型,而JNSP改变每个任务矢量的哪些组成部分进入合并。 两者的结合并不是自动的,结果取决于允许的适应内容. 改造合成锚地上的合并模型并不能到达我们运行中的无数据操作者:FDA从预先训练的重量分数86.93%开始,最好的变体从WUDI的88.47%的合并开始,达到88.90%(表26),仍然低于JNSP合并本身的89.45 % 。 因此,在我们的运行中,合成-锁定适应没有超过JNSP的合并,我们对此没有提出更广泛的主张。 提供少量真实样本不同:将8位专家分馏入JNSP,每任务256个真实训练图像,将它从89.4%提升到91.17%(附录Q. 对比点是论文的后半部分用其他术语绘制的: 合并决定了每项任务的更新贡献, 并且只有受监督的信号携带合并还没有的信息. 与持续学习的关系更加密切和谨慎。 连续预测是几种持续学习方法的核心机制[38、37、25],第5.3节显示,在合并情况下,这种预测崩溃为69.64%。 区别在于目标:持续学习接受命令依赖,因为它希望最新的任务能活下来,而合并应该是任务列表中的对称. 在没有目标的情况下重新使用机器,使每一项任务中最糟糕的任务都逐渐蒙上眼睛,任何任务都得不到优先保护。

blocks.en: The measured failure of the stronger orthogonality claim is not a reprieve for sequential merging, and the point of reporting it is to keep the two separate. At r = 8 r{=}8 the accumulated basis for the eighth task has dimension at most 56 56 ; whatever fraction of each delta those 56 directions capture is removed from the last-listed task and only that task, and the measured profile (Table 13 ) is exactly the directed pattern the nesting predicts: nearly intact early tasks (MNIST 99.59%, EuroSAT 93.81%), gutted late ones (RESISC45 64.78%, Cars 51.14%, SUN397 36.14%), with GTSRB an early exception that its retained norm ( 90.3 % 90.3\% ) does not explain. The instructive detail is SUN397. Listed last, it is projected against exactly its joint peer union, so its own projected delta is identical in the two merges (retention 0.909 0.909 in each), yet it loses 35 points. That loss cannot come from what is deleted from SUN397; it must come from the earlier tasks’ deltas, which sequential projection filters less (task 1 not at all). Neither a task’s own retained norm nor the aggregate retention ratio is therefore a proxy for its accuracy loss. Joint projection removes the position dependence entirely, which is the property Proposition 3 proves and the ablation confirms.
blocks.zh: 较强的正统性索赔经衡量的失败并不是对相继合并的缓刑,报告的关键是将两者分开。 在r = 8 r {=} 8 时,第八项任务的累积基数最多为 56 56;无论在每一三角洲中,56个方向捕捉的分量从最后列出的任务中除去,只有该任务,而且测量的剖面图(表13)正是筑巢预测的定向图案:几乎完整无损的早期任务(MNIST 99.59%,93.81%),被挖出后期任务(RESISC45 64.78%,51.14%,SUN397 36.14%),而GTSRB的早期例外是其保留规范(90.3% 90.3\%)没有解释的. 启发性细节为SUN397. 最后列出的是它相对于其联合同伴联盟的预测,因此它自己的预测三角洲在两个合并中是相同的(保留了0.909个0.909个),然而却损失了35分. 这种损失不能来自SUN397中删去的内容;它必须来自先前的任务三角洲,这些三角洲的相继投影过滤器更少(任务1根本不可能)。 因此,任务本身的保留准则和总的保留比率都不是准确性损失的代名词。 联合投影可以完全去除位置依赖性,即"提议3"所证明的地产,并证实衰竭.

blocks.en: The construction is superficially attractive—projecting each task against everything seen so far looks like the cleanest possible merge, with no interference by design. The cost is that interference is avoided by discarding, with the amount discarded determined by merge order rather than by the task. Joint projection achieves a different compromise: the increments are not orthogonal either, but each is projected against the same seven neighbours, so no position is privileged and the result is invariant to list order.
blocks.zh: 建造工程表面具有吸引力——将每项任务与迄今所看到的一切相比,看起来是最干净的合并,没有设计上的干扰。 成本是通过丢弃来避免干扰,丢弃的数量由合并顺序决定而不是由任务决定. 联合预测实现不同的折中:增量也不是正向的,但每个增量都是针对同一个7个邻国预测的,因此没有任何位置是特权的,结果也无从列出顺序.

blocks.en: Order invariance removes one class of tuning that the sequential construction exposes: there is no need to order tasks by importance or by data size, and no hidden dependence of the merged model on the order in which a file system lists checkpoints. It does not make the method insensitive to which tasks are merged, and it says nothing about the rank, which remains the single knob and is discussed in Appendix E . The sign statement is a consistency check on the parametrization rather than a practical procedure: it certifies that the construction does not assume all task vectors point the same way.
blocks.zh: 顺序变化消除了相继构造所暴露的一类调制:不需要根据重要性或数据大小来定出任务,而且合并模型不会隐藏对一个文件系统列出检查站的顺序的依赖. 它不会使合并任务的方法变得不敏感,它不会对军衔说出什么,而军衔仍然是单一的节点,并在附录E中讨论. 符号语句是对准音的一致检查,而不是实用的程序: 它证明构造并不承担所有任务向量的指向相同.

blocks.en: A ViT-B/16 encoder contains 53 two-dimensional weight tensors with min ⁡ ( shape ) ≥ 64 \min(\text{shape})\geq 64 . Forty-eight are the attention and MLP matrices of the 12 transformer blocks: one fused query–key–value projection, one output projection, and two MLP projections per block. The remaining five are the visual projection, the two positional embeddings, the text projection, and the token embedding. The three text-tower tensors are not on the image path: evaluation calls only the image encoder, so whatever the merge writes there cannot change a prediction. The re-implementation harness used for the subspace baselines merges every two-dimensional tensor except the text projection; on ViT-B/16 and ViT-L/14 this is the same set of image-path tensors (52 and 100), and JNSP scores 89.45 under both scopes on ViT-B/16. On ViT-B/32 that harness also merges the 50-position visual positional embedding, which moves JNSP from 82.92 to 82.91. These 53 tensors are the only ones the merge writes; layer norms, biases, and the per-task classification heads stay at their pretrained or task-specific values, and head selection is the only place task identity enters at evaluation time. The same filter yields 52 tensors for ViT-B/32—the visual positional embedding has only 50 positions and falls below the threshold—and 101 for ViT-L/14, where 24 blocks contribute 96 matrices and the same five extras pass.

blocks.en: JNSP has no stochastic component: the SVD of each delta, the QR orthonormalization of the stacked neighbour basis, and the projection are deterministic linear algebra. Re-running the merge reproduces the merged weights bit-for-bit on the same hardware. Variation in the reported means therefore comes only from evaluation sampling, which is what the bootstrap intervals in Appendix N quantify.
blocks.zh: JNSP没有分层组件:每个三角洲的SVD,堆叠相邻基础的QR正态化,投影是定型线性代数. 重新运行合并复制了合并后在同一硬件上的比特位. 因此,所报告手段的差异仅来自评价抽样,这就是附录N量化中的靴子间隔。

blocks.en: Every training-free baseline was given a sweep over its merge coefficient (TIES at density 0.2 0.2 , DARE at drop rate 0.9 0.9 ), and the best score on the eight-task average is reported in Table 1 . Table 5 records the full sweep. The optimum is sharp for all three methods: Task Arithmetic and DARE peak at λ = 0.2 \lambda{=}0.2 and lose more than 10 points at λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 ; TIES peaks at λ = 1.0 \lambda{=}1.0 with density 0.2 0.2 and loses 8 points at λ = 1.5 \lambda{=}1.5 . Reporting the peak rather than a default coefficient is the setting most favourable to the baselines, which matters for the size of our margin: at the coefficient a practitioner would naively choose— λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 for task arithmetic—the score is far below the peak.
blocks.zh: 每一个无培训基线都对其合并系数进行了扫描(密度为0.2的TIES、下降率为0.9 0.9的DERE),表1报告了八项任务平均值的最佳分数。 表5记录了整个扫描情况。 所有三种方法的最佳方法是尖锐的: 任务 Arithmetic and DARE 峰值为 = 0.2\lambda = 0.2,并在 = 0.5\lambda = 0.5 上损失了10分多; TIES 峰值为 = 1.0\lambda = 1.0,密度为 0.2,在 = 1.5\lambda = 1.5 上损失了8分. 报告峰值而不是默认系数是对基线最有利的设定,这对我们的比值大小很重要:在系数下,一个从业者会天真地选择——任务算术=1\lambda=1——得分远低于峰值.

blocks.en: The sweep here and the unified merge script draw different numbers for DARE at the same settings (74.91 here, 75.13 in the harness). The difference is not a hyperparameter: both use p = 0.9 p{=}0.9 , λ = 0.2 \lambda{=}0.2 , and the same Bernoulli rule. It is the tensor set. The sweep runs on the 53-tensor scope of Table 1 , which includes text_projection ; the harness’s all2d scope drops that one tensor, and because the drop mask is drawn from a seeded stream over the tensor list, removing one tensor shifts every subsequent draw. The two scores are therefore two realisations of the same stochastic operator, not two settings. Table 1 reports the lower of the two, which is the one on the declared comparison scope.
blocks.zh: 这里的扫描和统一合并的脚本在相同的设置中为DARE绘制了不同的数字(这里的74.91,在被套上75.13). 此差不是超参数:两者均使用p=0.9 p{=}0.9, =0.2\lambda{=}0.2,同为Bernoulli规则. 这是高压装置。 扫描范围为表1的53至10分, 包括text_project; 绳索的全2d瞄准镜将降出一个收分, 因此,两个分数是同一分数操作符的两个实现,而不是两个设置. 表1报告了两者中较低者,即申报的比较范围。

blocks.en: The per-dataset pattern behind the sweep is informative in its own right. At λ = 0.3 \lambda{=}0.3 task arithmetic improves on SVHN relative to its peak (88.18 versus 83.02) while collapsing on SUN397 (62.51 versus 68.29): the classes of coefficient that help easy tasks and the classes that are needed by fine-grained ones are not the same. A single global coefficient cannot satisfy both, which is the coordinatewise analogue of the interference this paper targets.
blocks.zh: 扫荡背后的每个数据集模式本身就是信息化的. = 0.3\lambda=0.3 任务算术相对于峰值(88.18对83.02)在SUN397(62.51对68.29)上崩溃时,SVHN会有所改进:帮助轻松完成任务的系数类别和被精细加分任务需要的类别不同. 单一的全球系数不能满足两者,这就是本文目标干扰的坐标模拟。

blocks.en: Tables 6 to 8 give the full per-dataset sweeps. Two regularities are worth recording. First, the per-task optima do not coincide: on task arithmetic, MNIST and SVHN prefer λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 and GTSRB prefers 0.3 0.3 , while EuroSAT, DTD, RESISC45, Cars, and SUN397 all prefer 0.2 0.2 . The eight-task average is therefore a compromise that underserves MNIST, GTSRB and SVHN, which is the reason a method with a per-task rule can beat a tuned global coefficient even when both are given their best shot. Second, the collapse at large coefficient is asymmetric across tasks: at λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 task arithmetic loses 40.0 points on SUN397 and 23.9 on RESISC45, while MNIST and SVHN actually gain 1.4 and 6.4 points relative to the λ = 0.2 \lambda{=}0.2 peak. Large coefficients amplify whichever directions dominate the sum, so whether a given task rises or falls depends on whether the globally amplified directions coincide with its own—precisely the interference this paper targets. The datasets that break (SUN397, RESISC45) are among the least shared with other tasks (Table 11 ), so sharing alone does not predict which tasks break.

blocks.en: The pairwise decomposition is informative about the failure structure of coordinatewise methods. The most entangled pair is MNIST–SVHN: 59.9% of MNIST’s norm lies in SVHN’s top-16 and 55.4% of SVHN’s lies in MNIST’s, so the two tasks claim the same input directions. Next are GTSRB–SVHN (46.1/49.2) and MNIST–GTSRB (48.5/43.7) (Table 12 ). MNIST and SVHN are among the tasks where TIES-Merging and Task Arithmetic score highest in Table 1 , so pairwise sharing does not by itself predict where coordinatewise methods fail. The least invasive tasks are SUN397 and Cars (row means 27.2 and 27.3): their deltas land in other tasks’ bases less than any others’, the mirror image of MNIST and SVHN (38.4 and 37.7), which occupy the most. We note that this is a statement about the deltas, not about margins— JNSP ’s per-dataset gain over TIES is 13.16 on Cars but 8.27 on SUN397, and it is smallest (0.36, 1.81) on MNIST and SVHN, the two most invasive tasks.
blocks.zh: 双相分解对协调方法的故障结构有启发性. 最缠绕的一对是MNIST–SVHN:59.9%的MNIST规范位于SVHN的前16名和55.4%的SVHN谎言位于MNIST,因此两项任务声称相同的输入方向. 接下来是GTSRB-SVHN(46.1/49.2)和MNIST-GTSRB(48.5/43.7)(表12)。 MNIST和SVHN是TIES-Merging和Task Arithmetic得分在表1中最高的任务之一,所以对等共享本身并不能预测协调方法失败的地方. 入侵性最小的任务有SUN397和车厢(行车量为27.2和27.3): 他们的三角洲位于其他任务的基础比任何其他任务都少。 我们注意到,这是关于三角洲的说明,而不是关于边际 -- -- JNSP对TIES的每个数据集收益在汽车上是13.16分,在SUN397上是8.27分,在MNIST和SVHN上是最小的(0.36分,1.81分),这是两个最侵入性的任务。

blocks.en: The matrix is not symmetric, and the asymmetry is informative. The row mean measures how much a task’s delta lands in other tasks’ bases—how invasive it is—while the column mean measures how much of the other seven tasks lands in its basis—how much territory it claims. MNIST and SVHN are the two most invasive tasks (row means 38.4 and 37.7); Cars and SUN397 are the two least (27.3 and 27.2). The column means are nearly flat, 30.5 to 34.9, so no task claims a disproportionate share of the shared volume; what differs is how much each task occupies the others’. This distinction has a practical consequence that resolves an apparent puzzle in the main table. One might expect the most invasive tasks to be the ones most affected by the joint projection, since they are the ones whose removal hurts their neighbours. But the projection removes from each task only what lies in its peers’ union, regardless of how invasive the task itself is, so invasiveness and vulnerability are different axes: MNIST is both invasive and strongly concentrated (83.7% of its norm in its own top-16), and it survives the merge at 99.07%, while SUN397 is neither invasive nor concentrated (50.1%) and lands at 74.97%. The tasks that score lowest after the merge (SUN397, Cars) are diffuse (own top-16 norm share 50.1% and 59.2%, Table 11 ) but the least overlapped; across these tasks low accuracy tracks diffuseness, not overlap.
blocks.zh: 矩阵不相对,而相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这行意味着衡量一项任务的三角洲在其它任务基地中的土地数量 -- -- 多么侵入性 -- -- 而这一行意味着衡量其他七项任务中有多少土地在其基地中 -- -- 它声称拥有多少领土。 MNIST和SVHN是两项最有侵犯性的任务(轮标为38.4和37.7);汽车和SUN397是两项最少的任务(27.3和27.2)。 纵栏的意思几乎是平平的,从30.5到34.9,因此没有一项任务占共享量的比例过高;不同的是每项任务占据了多少其他任务。 这种区分产生了实际后果,解决了主表中一个明显的谜题. 人们可能预期,受联合预测影响最大的是最具侵略性的任务,因为这些任务伤害了邻国。 但预测只消除了每个任务的同龄人联盟,不管任务本身是怎样的入侵性,因此入侵性和脆弱性是不同的轴心:MNIST既具有入侵性,又高度集中(其规范的83.7%在它自己的前16位),它在合并后以99.07%维持下来,而SUN397既不是入侵性,也不是集中性(50.1%),土地占74.97%。 合并后得分最低的任务(SUN397,车厢)是分散的(拥有前16个规范占50.1%和59.2%,表11),但重叠最少;在这些任务中,精度差的轨道分散,而不是重叠.

blocks.en: Section 5.3 reports that the sequential variant collapses to 69.64% at r = 8 r{=}8 against 88.03% for the joint merge. Figure 6 and Table 13 (below) decompose that collapse by task. The degradation grows with the position of the task in the merge list. The first two tasks are barely touched (99.59 and 93.81), the fourth still holds 88.78, and the losses then climb steadily through the tail of the list: 23.7, 25.8, 29.4, and 35.2 points for DTD, RESISC45, Cars, and SUN397. The one exception to the trend is GTSRB, which sits third in the list and drops to 72.19, 24.2 points below the joint merge; its retained norm (90.3%) does not explain the drop, and we do not attribute it to a specific overlap. The pattern is consistent with Proposition 2 : each task is projected against the union of every task that came before it, so the removed subspace grows monotonically, up to 56 directions for the last task at r = 8 r{=}8 ; at the same time, early tasks are never filtered against later ones (Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 第5.3节报告说,相继变体在r = 8 r = = 8 r = o = 88.03%的联合合并时崩溃为69.64%. 图6和表13(下)按任务分列了崩溃情况。 退化随着任务在合并列表中的位置而增加. 前两项任务几乎没有触及(99.59和93.81),而第四项任务仍然持有88.78分,损失随后从清单的尾部稳步攀升:23.7分,25.8分,29.4分和35.2分 DTD分,RESIC45分,汽车分和SUN397. 趋势的一个例外是GTSRB,GTSRB在列表中位居第三,并降至72.19分,比联合合并低24.2分;其保留规范(90.3%)并不能解释下降的原因,我们不把它归结为具体的重叠. 模式与Proposition 2一致:每个任务都是针对之前的每一个任务的结合而预测的,因此被移除的子空间会单调地增长,在r = 8 r{=}8 上一个任务最多有56个方向;同时,早期任务永远不会被过滤到后一个任务上(Appendix B 2. ).

blocks.zh: 表13: R = 8 r{=}8(ViT-B/16,%)的顺序合并与联合合并。 相继栏按所列顺序将各项任务合并,按照迄今积累的基础对每项任务进行预测;联合栏对同一七个邻国进行每项任务项目.

blocks.en: The retained-norm row is the interesting one. The sequential merge keeps more of the delta norm (35.90% versus 33.44%) and performs far worse. So the amount deleted does not explain the collapse. Each task loses only its overlap with earlier tasks; early tasks are never filtered against later ones, so their overlap with later tasks enters the sum unprojected. The joint construction filters every task against the same set of neighbours, which makes the per-task profile in Figure 6 independent of list position. This comparison suggests that which components are removed matters more than how much, but does not isolate it.
blocks.zh: 保留规范的一行是有趣的一行。 相继的合并使三角洲的规范得以保持(35.90%对33.44%),表现更糟糕。 所以删除的金额并不能解释崩溃的原因. 每个任务只失去与更早的任务的重叠;早期的任务从不被后期的任务过滤出,因此它们与后期任务的重叠输入未预测的总和. 联合建设将每个任务过滤到相同的相邻区域,这使得图6中的每个任务配置独立于列表位置. 这种比较表明,去除哪些部件比多少重要,但并不孤立。

Per-task retention spans 71.6 (SVHN) to 83.7 (Cars) at r = 16 r{=}16 , and the ordering is close to the opposite of what an “easy tasks are less disturbed” intuition would predict: the two tasks with the lowest retention, MNIST and SVHN, are among the highest -scoring, while SUN397 is among the highest-retention tasks and scores lowest. The correlation between retention and accuracy across the eight tasks is − 0.78 -0.78 . The variable that explains the ordering is the spectral concentration of the update, ϕ \phi : retention and ϕ \phi correlate at − 0.965 -0.965 at r = 16 r{=}16 , and the relation is stable across the rank sweep ( − 0.963 -0.963 , − 0.964 -0.964 , − 0.965 -0.965 , − 0.965 -0.965 at r = 8 , 12 , 16 , 20 r{=}8,12,16,20 ). blocks.en: Table 16 gives the full profile. Every module type loses ground as r r grows, but the rate of loss is unequal: the embedding and projection group falls from 71.4 to 58.9, while the MLP output projection falls only from 87.7 to 82.5, so the spread grows by about 40%, from 16.7 to 23.6 points, between r = 8 r{=}8 and r = 20 r{=}20 . The attention input, attention output and MLP input projections each fall by 11.3–11.5 points over the same range. The embedding and projection group is lowest at every rank; whether a per-module rank would help in accuracy is untested; the depth profile below suggests the room for improvement is limited, because interference is spread across depth rather than concentrated.
blocks.zh: 表16提供了完整的概况。 每个模块类型会随着r r 增长而失去地盘,但损失率是不平等的:嵌入和投影组从71.4降至58.9,而MLP输出预测从87.7降至82.5,因此分数增长约40%,从16.7分增至23.6分,在r = 8 r 和 r = 20 r r 20之间. 注意力输入、注意力输出和MLP输入预测在相同范围内每下降11.3-11.5分。 嵌入和投影组在每个级别都最低;每个单元的分级是否有助于准确性,没有经过测试;下面的深度剖面表明改进空间有限,因为干扰分散在深度之间而不是集中.

blocks.en: First, the joint merge always removes more than the shared control—by 2.03, 2.31, 2.47, 2.85 and 4.00 points at r = 8 r{=}8 , 12 12 , 16 16 , 20 20 and 32 32 —and yet always scores higher. If raw excision were the mechanism, the more aggressive method would be the more damaging one; it is not, which is consistent with the choice of which directions to remove mattering more than how many . Second, the score is not monotone in the retained fraction: retention falls from 33.44 to 30.36 between r = 8 r{=}8 and r = 16 r{=}16 while accuracy rises 1.42 points, and falls a further 1.2 points to 29.16 at r = 20 r{=}20 while accuracy falls 0.23. A plausible reading, not tested directly, is that the rank trades off covering the interfering directions (which needs large r r ) against deleting a task’s own content (which grows with r r ), with the optimum where the two balance.
blocks.zh: 首先,联合合并总是去除超过共享控制——由2.03, 2.31, 2.47, 2.85和 4.00分在r = 8 r{=}8, 12 12, 16, 20 和 32 32——但总得分较高. 如果原始割礼是一种机制,那么更具有攻击性的方法将是更有害的方法;它不是,这与选择哪一个方向去除比多少重要的东西是一致的。 第二,所保留的分数中分数不是单调:分数从33.44到30.36从r=8 r{=}8到r=16 r{=}16,而精度则会上升1.42分;再以r=20 r{=}20的分数,再降1.2分到29.16分,而精度会下降0.23. 一个没有直接测试的可信解读是,排位与干涉方向(需要大r r)相对应,而不是删除任务本身的内容(随着r 增长),最佳的两种平衡。

blocks.en: Three facts stand out. First, no pair is anywhere near orthogonal: the smallest entry, O MNIST , SUN397 = 0.130 O_{\text{MNIST},\text{SUN397}}{=}0.130 , is still 7.2 7.2 times the matched random baseline of 0.018 0.018 . Fine-tuning the same CLIP encoder on eight unrelated datasets does not produce independent row spaces: every task’s dominant directions overlap with every other task’s well beyond chance. This is the quantitative sense in which the projection touches every task.
blocks.zh: 三个事实突出. 首先,没有任何一对是接近正统的:最小的条目O MNIST , SUN397 = 0.130 O_{\text{MNIST},\text{SUN397}}{=}0.130,仍然是相匹配的0.0180.018随机基线的7.2 7.2倍. 在8个无关数据集上精细调整相同的 CLIP 编码器不会产生独立的行空格:每个任务的主要方向与每个其他任务远非偶然的重叠. 这就是预测触及每一项任务的量化意义。

blocks.en: Second, the spread across pairs is modest, a factor of 2.6 2.6 from weakest to strongest, so interference is broadly distributed rather than concentrated in a few pathological pairings. The three strongest pairs are MNIST–SVHN ( 0.338 0.338 ), GTSRB–SVHN ( 0.278 0.278 ) and EuroSAT–RESISC45 ( 0.272 0.272 ): digits with house numbers, two sign-and-number datasets, and two aerial-imagery datasets. The weakest are MNIST–SUN397 and SVHN–Cars (both 0.130 0.130 ).
blocks.zh: 第二,相对相对的分布不大,从最弱到最强的系数为2.6 2.6,因此干扰分布很广,而不是集中在少数病理相配. 三种最强的配对有:MIST-SVHN(0.338 0.338),GTSRB-SVHN(0.278 0.278)和EuroSAT-RESISC45(0.272 0.272):有房号的数位数,有2个标志和数字数据集,有2个航空图像数据集. 最弱的是MNIST-SUN397和SVHN-Cars(均为0.130 0.130.

blocks.en: Third, the union bound is not the binding constraint. Seven neighbours contribute at most 7 ​ r = 112 7r{=}112 directions out of 768 768 , so the projection can remove at most 15 % 15\% of the input dimensions; yet each task loses 22 % 22\% of its delta norm on average (per-task retention 77.8 % 77.8\% , Table 15 ), more than the 8 % 8\% an isotropic delta would lose, so the removed directions are ones the deltas concentrate on. (The aggregate merged norm, 30.4 % 30.4\% of the summed norms, is a different quantity; Appendix I .)
blocks.zh: 第三,约束工会不是约束性的制约。 7个邻居最多贡献了7r=112 7r{=}112个方向,在768 768个方向中,因此预测最多可以去除15% 15\%的输入维度;然而每项任务平均损失了22% 22\%的三角洲标准(每任务保留77.8% 77.8\%,表15),超过8% 8\%的同位素三角洲将失去,因此被去掉的方向是三角洲所关注的方向. (汇总合并规范,30.4%为30.4%的汇总规范,数量不同;附录一.)

blocks.en: A natural objection is that O i ​ j O_{ij} measures what it measures because all eight deltas look alike—if every fine-tuned model moved its weights in a similar overall direction, any two rank- r r subspaces drawn from them would overlap. The right control is the entrywise cosine between the flattened deltas, ⟨ vec ​ Δ i , vec ​ Δ j ⟩ / ( ‖ Δ i ‖ ​ ‖ Δ j ‖ ) \langle\mathrm{vec}\,\Delta_{i},\mathrm{vec}\,\Delta_{j}\rangle/(\left\lVert\Delta_{i}\right\rVert\left\lVert\Delta_{j}\right\rVert) , which is 1 1 for identical deltas and averages 0 0 for independent random matrices of the same size. Averaged over the 53 tensors, the off-diagonal entrywise cosine is 0.083 0.083 (Table 17 ), comfortably above zero but far below the subspace overlap of 0.179 0.179 . The two matrices are strongly related—the correlation across the 28 distinct pairs is 0.843 0.843 —but they are not the same measurement, and the pairs that separate are informative. MNIST–SVHN has both the largest entrywise cosine ( 0.214 0.214 ) and the largest subspace overlap ( 0.338 0.338 ); DTD–SUN397 has a near-average entrywise cosine ( 0.078 0.078 ) yet an overlap of 0.206 0.206 , more than twice EuroSAT–Cars ( 0.144 0.144 ) whose entrywise cosine is only slightly lower ( 0.068 0.068 ). Entrywise similarity explains much of the ordering and not all of it; the remainder reflects row-space structure that an entrywise cosine does not measure.

blocks.en: The per-task and aggregate retention figures measure different things, and the gap is the mechanism. Per task at r = 16 r{=}16 , ‖ 𝝉 ~ i ‖ / ‖ 𝝉 i ‖ \left\lVert\tilde{\bm{\tau}}_{i}\right\rVert/\left\lVert\bm{\tau}_{i}\right\rVert averages 0.78 0.78 (range 0.72 0.72 on MNIST and SVHN to 0.84 0.84 on Cars): each task keeps most of its own update. Per tensor, the merged sum ‖ ∑ i 𝝉 ~ i ‖ \left\lVert\sum_{i}\tilde{\bm{\tau}}_{i}\right\rVert is only 30.4 % 30.4\% of ∑ i ‖ 𝝉 i ‖ \sum_{i}\left\lVert\bm{\tau}_{i}\right\rVert (Table 14 ). If the eight projected deltas were mutually orthogonal, a per-task retention of 0.778 0.778 would give 0.778 / 8 = 27.5 % 0.778/\sqrt{8}=27.5\% ; the measured 30.4 % 30.4\% is 2.9 2.9 points above that. This is consistent with the projection removing most of the coherent cross-task accumulation while each task keeps most of its own update.

SUN397 is both the least concentrated and our weakest task ( 74.97 % 74.97\% ), and the rank does not help it: raising r r from 16 16 to 32 32 buys SUN397 0.8 0.8 points while costing 2.4 2.4 on the eight-task average (Table 10 ). blocks.en: The correlation does not extend to the margin: against TIES-Merging, concentration correlates only weakly, at r = − 0.31 r{=}-0.31 . blocks.en: The objection describes a compression : Δ i \Delta_{i} is replaced by Δ i ​ 𝑽 i ​ 𝑽 i ⊤ \Delta_{i}\bm{V}_{i}\bm{V}_{i}^{\top} , so everything outside its own top- r r space is deleted, and a low- σ i \sigma_{i} direction with high functional value is lost without recourse. Our re-implementation of the compression-based TSV-M loses 1.8 points against its published score (Section 4.3 ), whether this compression accounts for the gap is not tested here. In ( 3 ) the basis plays a different role: 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} is never used to project Δ i \Delta_{i} —it is excluded from 𝑼 ∪ ( i ) \bm{U}^{(i)}_{\cup} —and the only thing deleted is Δ i \Delta_{i} ’s component inside other tasks’ top- r r spaces, which can include part of 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . A direction that is low-energy for task i i and not dominant for any neighbour is retained in full, at any σ i \sigma_{i} , so the singular-value ordering never decides what task i i keeps.

blocks.en: It survives for one configuration: a direction that is low- σ i \sigma_{i} , dominant for exactly one neighbour j j , and at the same time carries real function for task i i . Equations ( 1 )–( 3 ) cannot tell that case apart from a genuinely shared direction, and the broad rank plateau of Figure 5 —while consistent with the operator removing mostly redundancy—is not a functional probe. Two claims should therefore be kept apart. Verified : the operator does not truncate Δ i \Delta_{i} to 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} ; the part of 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} lying in the peer union is, however, deleted (Proposition 1 ). Unverified : whether the deleted directions carry function for the task that loses them, and whether an activation-space basis of the kind ESM fits would select a better deletion set. Settling the second would need per-example forward passes over task data, which is exactly the cost data-freedom avoids.

blocks.en: Figure 4 (Section 4.2 ) shows the single-image comparison; the numbered results below refer to it.

blocks.en: Of 87,432 evaluation images, 7,102 satisfy the condition that JNSP is correct while both entrywise baselines err; the reverse condition—both baselines correct, JNSP wrong—holds on 995. The ratio is 7.1 to 1. Table 19 breaks this down by dataset. The ratio is highest where the accuracy gap is largest (EuroSAT 29.5, GTSRB 195) and lowest on MNIST and SUN397 (3.6 and 2.9), where the baselines are already close to their ceiling or where all methods struggle. GTSRB is extreme because both baselines score far below JNSP on that dataset (71.1 and 71.9 versus 96.3) while almost never being right where JNSP is wrong; we do not test why.
blocks.zh: 在87,432份评价图像中,7,102份符合JNSP正确而两个入门基线都是错误的条件;反向条件——两个基线都正确,JNSP错误地坚持995年。 比率为7.1比1. 表19按数据集分列。 在准确性差距最大(29.5号欧洲卫星,GTSRB 195号),在MNIST和SUN397(3.6和2.9号)上最低,基线已接近其上限或所有方法都困难的地方,比率最高。 GTSRB是极端的,因为两个基线在该数据集(71.1和71.9对96.3)上的得分都远低于JNSP,而在JNSP错误的地方几乎永远不对;我们不测试原因。

blocks.en: Table 19 : Per-image agreement with the two entrywise baselines (ViT-B/16, counts of evaluation images). “Ours only” counts images where JNSP is correct and both TIES-Merging and Task Arithmetic err; “baselines only” is the reverse.
blocks.zh: 表19:与两个入门基线的人均图像协议(ViT-B/16,评价图像的计数)。 “只有我们”计算JNSP正确和TIES-Merging和任务算术错误的图像;“只有基线”则相反。

blocks.en: On Cars and DTD, TIES-Merging and Task Arithmetic both predict a class adjacent to the ground truth in the fine-grained hierarchy—a different make of car, a similar texture category—whereas JNSP is correct. On EuroSAT and RESISC45 the baselines tend to predict a plausible same-domain class (urban versus industrial land use, a sports field versus a meadow), These are observations on the sampled images of Figure 4 ; we do not test which directions carry the decision boundary.
blocks.zh: 在汽车和DTD上,TIES-Merging和Task Arithmetic都预测在细纹等级中与地面真理相相接的一等——一种不同的汽车造型,一种类似的纹理类别——因为JNSP是正确的. 在EuroSAT和ResISC45上,基线倾向于预测一个合理的相同领域(城市与工业用地、运动场与草地), 这些是图4样本图像上的观测结果;我们不测试哪个方向带有决定边界。
