blocks.en: A single dataset average therefore conceals two different regimes: what a merge must preserve for a coarse task is a small decision boundary over well-separated classes. For a fine-grained task it must preserve hundreds of boundaries of uneven difficulty, and the aggregate is dominated by the ones it loses.
blocks.zh: 因此,单一数据集平均值掩盖了两种不同的制度:合并必须为一项粗糙的任务保留什么是分明的类别上的一个小决定边界。 对于一项精细的任务,它必须保留数百个不均匀难度的界限,而总量则被它失去的界限所支配.

blocks.en: Figure 9 (b) plots the per-class standard deviation against the spectral concentration ϕ \phi of Figure 8 (b). The relation is close to linear over the full range— SD ≈ − 42.4 ​ ϕ + 27.9 \mathrm{SD}\approx-42.4\,\phi+27.9 , r = − 0.893 r{=}-0.893 , R 2 = 0.80 R^{2}{=}0.80 —and is a stronger statement than the correlation between ϕ \phi and accuracy already noted in Appendix J . Accuracy tells us that low-concentration tasks score worse; the spread tells us how they score worse. The most concentrated delta (MNIST, ϕ = 0.656 \phi{=}0.656 ) has the most uniform per-class recall, the least concentrated (SUN397, ϕ = 0.263 \phi{=}0.263 ) one of the most spread. We do not test a per-class mechanism; that would require per-class task vectors.
blocks.zh: 图9 (b) 对照图8 (b)中的光谱浓度 \\phi 绘制出每类标准差。 关系在全程上接近线性——SD − − − 42.4 → + 27.9\mathrm{SD − 近似-42.4\,\phi+27.9,r = − 0.893 r − 0.893,R 2 = 0.80 R^{2}{=} 0.80——是比附录J已经指出的\\ phi与准确性之间的关联更强的表述. 准确性告诉我们,低浓度任务得分更差;这一分数告诉我们它们如何得分更差。 其中最集中的三角洲(MNIST, = 0.656\phi{=}0.656)每等召回最统一,最集中的三角洲(SUN397, = 0.263\phi{=}0.263)是分布最广的三角洲之一. 我们不测试每类机制;这需要每类任务矢量。

blocks.en: Table 21 : Most frequent confusions of JNSP at r = 16 r{=}16 , as (predicted, true) class-index pairs with the number of affected evaluation images. Indices follow each dataset’s native label order, so adjacency in the table is not semantic adjacency; the table localises where errors concentrate rather than naming the confusion. The largest single pair on every dataset is listed, together with the next two.
blocks.zh: 表21:在r=16 r{=}16时,JNSP最常被混淆为(预想的,真实的)与受影响评价图像数的类索引对. 索引遵循了每个数据集的本地标签顺序,所以表中的相接性不是语义相接;表中的相接性是错误集中的地方,而不是命名混乱的地方. 每个数据集上最大的一对与下两对一起列出.

blocks.en: Table 21 lists the three most frequent (predicted, true) pairs for each task. Two regimes again appear. On MNIST and EuroSAT the largest pair concerns fewer than 20 of the 1,000 1{,}000 and 270 270 test images per class, so no single boundary accounts for the residual error; the remaining mistakes are scattered across many pairs. On SVHN, by contrast, a single unordered pair between classes 4 and 1 accounts for 198 errors—both directions, at comparable counts ( 106 106 and 92 92 )—far more than the third-ranked pair (82). On Cars the two largest pairs, (83,82) and (70,63), each account for 20 errors. We do not test whether these confusions arise from the merge or are already present in the expert.
blocks.zh: 表21列出每项任务中最常出现的三种(预测的,真实的)配对. 两个政权再次出现. 在MNIST和EuroSAT上,每类1000个1{,}000和270个270个测试图像中,最大的一对涉及不到20个,因此对所余误差没有单一的边界说明;所余误差分散在许多对中. 相比之下,在SVHN方面,4级和1级之间的单对无序对差数为198个差数——在可比数(106-106和92-92)中均为方向——远超过第三级对差数(82)。 在汽车上,两对最大的对(83,82和70,63),每对都记有20个错误. 我们不检验这些混淆是合并引起的,还是专家已经出现。

blocks.en: The concentration and confusion analyses together locate where a data-free merge loses accuracy, but neither identifies a repair within the family of linear projections of Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 集中和混淆分析一起确定无数据的合并会失去准确性的位置,但两者都无法确定第3节线性预测的修复情况。

blocks.en: Appendix N Per-Task Confidence Intervals
blocks.zh: 附录 N 任务间信任

blocks.en: Table 22 reports the bootstrap intervals behind the aggregates in Section 4 . The merge is deterministic, so the variability shown is evaluation-sampling variability under the held-out protocol, not seed variance over training. The intervals are 2,000-resample percentile intervals, and because the eight task estimates are computed on disjoint image sets they can be combined into an average interval by resampling each task independently.
blocks.zh: 表22报告了第4节中总数后面的靴子间隔。 合并是决定性的,因此显示的可变性是被搁置协议下的评价-抽样可变性,而不是种子差异大于训练. 间隔为2,000-再样本百分位相距,由于8项任务估计是在脱节相接的相机上计算出来的,因此可以通过独立地对每项任务进行再模拟,将它们合并为平均相距.

blocks.en: Table 22 : Per-dataset bootstrap intervals for JNSP at r = 16 r{=}16 (ViT-B/16). Intervals are 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 resamples of the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 表22: r = 16 r{=}16 (ViT-B/16)时,JNSP的每个数据集靴子间隔. 从2 000个评价套件的复标值中,间隔率为95%。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Bootstrap intervals, both checkpoint releases. Point estimates and 95% percentile intervals over the evaluation set ( 2,000 2{,}000 resamples) for the eight tasks, our ViT-B/16 checkpoints and the independently trained TALL release. Intervals are narrow where the test set is large and the task is saturated, and widest on DTD—the smallest test set (1,880 images) at a mid-range accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图10:靴子夹间隔,两次检查站放行. 在八项任务、我们的Vit-B/16检查站以及经过独立训练的TALL释放中, 在试验集大而任务饱和并最宽的DTD上——中程精度最小的试验集(1,880个图像)上,相接器是狭长的.

blocks.en: Figure 10 plots the intervals rather than tabulating them, so the two releases can be compared row by row. The same protocol applied to the independently trained TALL ViT-B/16 release gives 89.20 with interval [ 88.90 , 89.51 ] [88.90,\,89.51] . The two intervals overlap over most of their range, as expected if the difference between releases (0.25 points) is smaller than the evaluation noise, and the TIES-Merging point estimate of 77.57 lies below both.
blocks.zh: 图10绘制了间隔而不是列表,因此可以逐行比较两个版本. 适用于独立训练的TALL VIT-B/16发行的同一项协议给出了89.20的间隔[88.90, 89.51] [88.90,\,89.51]. 这两种间隔在大部分范围内是重叠的,预计释放(0.25分)之间的差别会小于评价噪声,而TIES-Merging点估计的77.57分位于两者下方。

blocks.en: The widths track the test-set size, not the difficulty of the merge. DTD has the widest interval ( ± 1.9 \pm 1.9 points) because it has the smallest evaluation set ( 1,880 1{,}880 images); SUN397, with ten times as many images, is accurate to about ± 0.6 \pm 0.6 despite scoring 2.3 points below DTD. WUDI’s 88.47, 0.98 points below ours, lies outside both average intervals; we report no interval for WUDI. The TIES, Task Arithmetic and DARE scores of Table 1 differ from ours by more than our per-dataset interval half-width on every one of the eight tasks. The intervals also do not speak to checkpoint-to-checkpoint variation during fine-tuning; the two-release comparison is our substitute for that, since each release comes from a different pipeline.
blocks.zh: 宽度跟踪测试设置大小,而不是合并的难度. DTD拥有最宽的间隔(±1.9\pm 1.9分),因为它拥有最小的评价集(1,880 1{,}880个图像);SUN397,其图像是图像数的十倍,准确到±0.6\pm 0.6左右,尽管在DTD下方得分2.3分. WUDI的88.47分,比我们低0.98分,在两个平均间隔之外;我们报告WUDI没有间隔。 表1的TIES、任务算术和DARE的分数与我们的分数不同,在8项任务中,每项任务中,每个数据集的分数相去甚远。 在微调时,间隔时间也不适用于检查站与检查站之间的变化;我们用两个释放比较来代替这一点,因为每个释放都来自不同的管道。

blocks.en: Appendix O Paired Significance Over Shared Test Items
blocks.zh: 附录O 共同试验项目的重要性

blocks.en: The intervals of Appendix N treat each method’s accuracy as an independent estimate. It is not: every method is evaluated on the same test images, so the relevant question is not whether two marginal intervals overlap but whether the two methods disagree on the same items in a consistent direction. We therefore report exact McNemar tests, on the b b items JNSP gets right and the baseline gets wrong and the c c items the baseline gets right and JNSP gets wrong. Under the null hypothesis b b and c c are draws from a fair coin, and the exact two-sided p p -value is the binomial tail with n = b + c n=b+c . Table 23 gives the result per task for both training-free baselines.
blocks.zh: 附录N的间隔将每种方法的准确性作为独立的估计。 不是:每一种方法都是在同一个测试图像上评价的,所以相关的问题不是两个边间隔是否重叠,而是两种方法在同一个项目上是否有一致的方向上的分歧. 因此,我们报告精确的McNemar测试, 在b项目上,JNSP得到正确和基线错误,c项目得到基线和JNSP得到错误。 在无效假说b和c下取自公平硬币,而确切的双面p-值为有n=b+cn=b+c的二元尾. 表23列出了两项无培训基线的每项任务的结果。

blocks.en: Table 23 : Paired McNemar tests on shared test items (ViT-B/16). b b : items JNSP classifies correctly and the baseline does not. c c : the reverse. Δ \Delta is the accuracy difference in percentage points and p p the exact two-sided binomial test. Pooling adds the discordant counts across all eight tasks; the pooled Δ \Delta is ( b − c ) / 87,432 (b-c)/87{,}432 , an item-weighted difference, and therefore differs from the difference of the equal-weight averages in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表23:Paired McNemar在共享测试项目上的测试(ViT-B/16)。 b: JNSP项目分类正确,基线不正确。 c: 反转。 \\Delta是百分点的精度差和p的精确双侧双相测试. 集合法增加了所有八项任务的不协调计数;集合法为 (b-c) / 87,432 (b-c)/87{,}432 ,这是项加权相差,因此不同于表1中的等重平均值相差.

blocks.en: The paired view sharpens the argument in two places where the marginal intervals are uninformative. On MNIST, JNSP leads TIES by only 0.36 points, less than the full width of our own interval (0.38); the paired test still separates them at 7 × 10 − 5 7\times 10^{-5} because the disagreement is asymmetric, 58 items to 22. Conversely, on SUN397 a moderate margin against TIES (8.27, against 24.40 on GTSRB) coexists with the largest discordant mass (3,233 items). Margin and significance are therefore not interchangeable summaries, and the pooled row is the honest global statement: over 87,432 shared test items, JNSP is correct on 11,585 items where Task Arithmetic fails and 1,492 where it succeeds, and 9,446 against 1,608 for TIES.
blocks.zh: 相配的取景使两地的争论更加尖锐,边缘间隔不通. 在MNIST上,JNSP带领TIES只领先了0.36分,比我们自己的间隔(0.38分)的全宽还小;对接测试仍然以7×10−5 7\times 10×5}分开,因为分歧是不对称的,58个项目到22个. 反之,在SUN397上,对TIES(8.27起,对GTSRB24.40起)的中度比值与最大的不和量(3 233件)并存。 因此边际和意义不能互换摘要,集合行是诚实的全球声明:超过87,432个共享测试项目,JNSP正确处理11,585个任务Arithmetic故障项目和1,492个成功项目,9,446对TIES1,608个.

blocks.en: The c c column is not noise to be dismissed. TIES beats JNSP on 391 SVHN items and 233 Cars items, and the SVHN count is large enough to be a systematic difference rather than a tail; one possible cause, not tested here, is TIES’s sign election. That is consistent with TIES remaining within two points of JNSP on SVHN in the main table while trailing by 8.27 to 24.40 points on the six tasks other than MNIST and SVHN. No single merge rule dominates item by item, and a method that combined per-task sign election with per-task subspace protection might recover these items; we did not pursue this because the SVHN margin is small compared with the deficits the same step creates elsewhere.
blocks.zh: c栏不是要删除的噪音。 TIES在391 SVHN项目和233辆汽车项目上击败了JNSP,SVHN的计数足够大,成为系统差异而不是尾巴;一个可能的原因,没有在这里测试,是TIES的标志选择. 这与TIES在主表中SVHN上的JNSP两分之内,在除MNIST和SVHN以外的六项任务上落后于8.27至24.40分一致. 没有单一的合并规则逐项支配项目,将每个任务符号选择与每个任务子空间保护相结合的方法可能会收回这些项目;我们没有追求这一点,因为SVHN的比值与其他地方产生的同一个步骤的不足相比很小.

blocks.en: Sixteen tests are reported across the two panels. A Bonferroni correction at family-wise α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 requires p < 3.1 × 10 − 3 p<3.1\times 10^{-3} ; the largest of the sixteen p p -values is 7.0 × 10 − 5 7.0\times 10^{-5} (MNIST versus TIES), and every cell is below the threshold. The conclusion does not depend on the correction.
blocks.zh: 两个面板共报告16个测试。 Bonferroni更正,在家庭角度 α = 0.05\alpha {=}0.05需要p < 3.1 × 10 − 3 p < 3.1\times 10^{-3};16个p - 值中的最大值为 7.0× 10 - 5 7.0\times 10^{-5}(MINIST vers TIES),每个单元格都低于阈值. 结论并不取决于更正。

blocks.en: Appendix P Backbone Scaling, Per Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录P 后骨 每个数据集缩放

blocks.en: Table 2 of the main text reports eight rows per backbone. Tables 24 and 25 repeat JNSP and the three parameter-wise baselines for ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14. Summed over the merged tensors and the eight tasks, the task-vector Frobenius norm is 136.28 for ViT-B/32 (52 tensors) and 304.18 for ViT-L/14 (101 tensors); the larger figure tracks the wider hidden dimension rather than a larger interference problem. All numbers come from the TALL release, so cross-method comparisons within a table are apples-to-apples.
blocks.zh: 主文表2报告每根骨干有8行. 表24和25重复了JNSP和Vit-B/32和Vit-L/14的三个参数基准。 在合并的百分数和八项任务中,任务执行者Frobenius的规范是:VIT-B/32(52个百分数)的136.28;VIT-L/14(101个百分数)的304.18;较大的数字跟踪更广泛的隐藏维度而不是更大的干扰问题. 所有数字都来自TALL发行,所以一个表格中的交叉方法比较是苹果对应用.

blocks.en: Table 24 : ViT-B/32, full per-dataset results (TALL release, %). JNSP uses r = 16 r{=}16 , untuned.
blocks.zh: 表24:Vit-B/32,每个数据集的全部结果(TALL发布,%)。 JNSP使用r=16 r{=}16,未调取.

blocks.en: Table 25 : ViT-L/14, full per-dataset results (TALL release, %). JNSP uses r = 16 r{=}16 , untuned.
blocks.zh: 表25:Vit-L/14,每个数据集的全部结果(TALL发布,%)。 JNSP使用r=16 r{=}16,未调取.

blocks.en: Three patterns hold across capacities. On all three backbones JNSP places first and the training-free baselines keep the same order: TIES above Task Arithmetic and DARE, which are within 0.7 points of each other on every backbone, with the subspace family (TSV-M, Iso-C) between TIES and JNSP . The margin over TIES is 10.84, 12.61, and 9.14 points on B/16, B/32, and L/14 respectively. Per dataset, JNSP on B/32 is below B/16 on all eight datasets, by 0.3 points on MNIST to 12.6 on Cars; L/14 averages 1.7 points above B/16 and is higher on six of the eight datasets, with EuroSAT and RESISC45 lower.
blocks.zh: 三种模式贯穿各种能力。 在所有三个主干线上,JNSP位居第一位,而无训练基线则保持相同的顺序:TIES上方的TS Arithmetic和DARE,它们在每个主干线上相接相接0.7分以内,与TIES和JNSP之间的子空间家族(TSV-M,Iso-C)相接. 对TIES的比值分别为10.84分,12.61分和B/16分,B/32分和L/14分9.14分. 每个数据集,B/32上的JNSP在所有8个数据集上都低于B/16,在MNIST上比12.6的车多0.3分;L/14上比B/16上平均1.7分,在8个数据集中的6个数据集上较高,EuroSAT和RESIC45更低.

blocks.en: Appendix Q Data-Using Baselines and Post-Merge Adaptation
blocks.zh: 附录Q 数据使用基线和元后适应

blocks.en: Table 1 contains only data-free rows. Table 26 adds the synthetic-anchor FDA rows and two data-free cascades that apply DARE or TIES after the JNSP projection. This section also reports the one experiment in the paper that uses real data after the merge: distillation of the eight experts into the JNSP merge, which is the data-using counterpart of the data-free operator and is not a row of Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表1只包含无数据行. 表26在JNSP预测后增加了合成-锁定FDA行和两套适用DERE或TIES的无数据级联. 本节还报道了论文中一个在合并后使用真实数据的实验:将8位专家分馏入JNSP合并,这是无数据操作器的数据使用对应,不是一行表1.

blocks.en: WUDI’s released operator merges the four attention and MLP projection weights of each of the twelve blocks—48 tensors—and leaves five two-dimensional tensors at their pretrained values: the text token embedding, the two positional embeddings, the visual projection, and the text projection. Across the eight tasks these five carry between 0.78% (RESISC45) and 1.81% (GTSRB) of the squared Frobenius norm of the 53-tensor delta—at most 1.9% on every task—so its 88.47% is obtained on a smaller scope than the 53-tensor scope used by every other row of Table 1 . We do not test whether this scope difference favours either method.
blocks.zh: WUDI的释放操作员将十二个块中的每一个块的四分注意力和MLP投影权重——48个收分数——合并起来,并留下五个二维取分数,按其预先训练的数值:文本符嵌入,两个位置嵌入,视觉投影,和文本投影. 在8项任务中,这5项任务在53至10分之三的平方Frobenius规范(RESISC45)和1.81%(GTSRB)之间,在每项任务中最高为1.9%,因此,其88.47%的范围比表1其他各行所用的53至10分之范围要小。 我们不检验这种范围差异是否有利于这两种方法。

blocks.en: Table 26 : FDA and cascade variants, per dataset (ViT-B/16, %). The FDA and WUDI-init FDA rows generate synthetic anchors per task and adapt the merged model on them (from the pretrained model and from the WUDI merge, respectively); neither sees a real image. The JNSP → \to DARE and JNSP → \to TIES rows apply DARE or TIES to the projected task vectors and are data-free. WUDI is the released data-free consensus merge, scored without adaptation. The rightmost column is the eight-task average; bold marks the column maximum.
blocks.zh: 表26:每个数据集的FDA和级联变体(ViT-B/16,%)。 FDA和WUDI-init FDA行生成每个任务的合成锚并调整上面的被合并模型(分别取自被预先训练的模型和WUDI的合并);两行都看不到真实的形象. JNSP →\ to DARE和 JNSP →\ to TIES行将 DARE 或 TIES 应用到预计的任务矢量中,并且是无数据的. WUDI是所发布的无数据共识合并,得分后不作修改. 最右边一栏为八任务平均值;粗体标出一栏最大值.

blocks.en: The comparison is not matched in data or compute: FDA adapts the merged model on synthetic anchors, while JNSP uses no images and no adaptation. Against plain FDA, JNSP is ahead on six of eight datasets. FDA leads on MNIST (by 0.31) and SVHN (by 2.15). JNSP ’s margin is largest on DTD (77.23 versus 69.84) and RESISC45 (93.22 versus 87.83), where synthetic anchors may capture coarse class structure but not fine distinctions. The JNSP → \to TIES row applies TIES-style trimming and sign election after the JNSP projection, and averages 75.55 ( JNSP → \to DARE, the analogous cascade with DARE, averages 86.99); its weakest datasets are GTSRB (60.3) and DTD (59.3). WUDI’s data-free merge reaches 88.47, and starting the same adaptation from it adds 0.43 points (88.90). Against this stronger variant, WUDI-init FDA leads on MNIST (by 0.33), EuroSAT (by 0.26), GTSRB (by 0.06) and SVHN (by 2.42), while JNSP leads on DTD (by 2.97), RESISC45 (by 2.11), Cars (by 1.56) and SUN397 (by 0.86).
blocks.zh: 数据或计算中不匹配比较:FDA在合成锚地上调整了被合并的模型,而JNSP则不使用图像,也不进行修改. 与FDA相比,JNSP领先于8个数据集中的6个. FDA领先于MNIST(0.31)和SVHN(2.15). JNSP的比值在DTD(77.23对69.84)和ResISC45(93.22对87.83)上最大,其中合成锚可能捕捉粗细的类结构,但不是细细细的区别. JNSP →\to TIES行在 JNSP 预测后采用 TIES 风格的修剪并签名选择,平均值为 75.55 (JNSP →\ to DARE,与 DARE 相类似的级联,平均值为 86.99;其最弱的数据集为 GTSRB (60.3)和 DTD (59.3). WUDI的无数据合并达到了88.47分,从它开始同样的修改增加了0.43分(88.90分). 针对这个更强的变体,WUDI-init FDA领先于MNIST(比0.33),EuroSAT(比0.26),GTSRB(比0.06)和SVHN(比2.42),而JNSP领先于DTD(比2.97),RESSC45(比2.11),车(比1.56)和SUN397(比0.86).

blocks.en: The FDA rows adapt on synthetic anchors and never see a real image. As a data-using reference point, we take the JNSP merge at r = 16 r{=}16 and distill the eight fine-tuned experts into it: the student is the merged model with every parameter trainable, the teachers are the eight expert encoders with their frozen heads, and the loss is a KL divergence to the teachers’ soft targets (temperature 2) on 4 × 64 = 256 4\times 64=256 real training images per task, drawn from each task’s held-out-from-test split. Training uses AdamW at learning rate 10 − 6 10^{-6} with a cosine schedule for 600 steps, and accuracy is evaluated at 200, 400 and 600 steps on the official test sets. Table 27 gives the result on all three backbones.
blocks.zh: FDA行在合成锚上适应,从来没有看到真实的形象. 作为使用数据的参考点,我们把JNSP合并在r = 16 r = 16 并提炼出八位精细化的专家进去:学生是每个参数可训练的被合并模型,教师是八位被冻结头部的专家编码器,损失是KL在4×64 = 256 4\times 64= 256真实的训练图像,从每个任务被阻断的测试分出. 训练使用 AdamW 的学习速度为 10 - 6 10 - 6 = ,600 步的余弦表,在正式测试集上,精确度被评价为 200,400和600步. 表27列出了所有三个骨干部门的结果。

blocks.en: Table 27 : Post-merge expert distillation (%). Student initialized from the data-free JNSP merge at r = 16 r{=}16 , then trained on 256 real images per task against the eight expert teachers. All numbers are our own runs on the same evaluator as Table 1 . CE is cross-entropy on ground-truth labels instead of distillation. The ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 rows use the TALL release; the B/32 student starts from the re-implementation-harness merge (82.91; Appendix C ).

blocks.en: Distillation lifts every backbone, by + 1.72 +1.72 (B/16), + 5.04 +5.04 (B/32) and + 1.75 +1.75 (L/14) points, and the B/16 run improves further to 91.41 at 1200 steps and 91.40 at 1800, so 600 steps is not saturating the budget. Two qualifications keep this out of the head-to-head comparison. First, the gain is mostly supervised learning, not the teachers: replacing the KL term with plain cross-entropy on the same images gives 90.85 (B/16), 87.77 (B/32) and 92.57 (L/14), within 0.32 of the distillation rows. Second, the method uses real training-split images (and, in the CE variant, their labels), which the data-free baselines of Table 1 do not; it is reported as the ceiling a small amount of real data reaches from this initialization, not as a training-free merge. Read together with the FDA rows, the comparison is consistent: synthetic adaptation moves the merge by at most 0.43 points and stays below it (88.90), whereas 256 real images per task move it by 1.7–5.0 points. A supervised signal on a few hundred images reduces the remaining error further.
blocks.zh: 分馏提升出每个主干,分数为+1.72+1.72(B/16),+ 5.04+5.04(B/32)和+1.75+1.75(L/14)分,而B/16跑在1200步和1800步分别进一步提高到91.41分和91.40分,因此600步不饱和预算. 两种资格都不让这出现在头与头的对比中. 首先,收益大多是监督学习,而不是教师:在蒸馏行的0.32个范围内,在相同的图像上用平地横穿来取代KL一词,给出90.85(B/16)、87.77(B/32)和92.57(L/14)。 第二,该方法使用真实的训练-分解图像(以及CE变体中,其标签),表1的无数据基线没有使用;它作为上限报告,从这个初始化中到达了少量真实数据,而不是作为无培训的合并. 与FDA行一并读取,比较一致:合成适应移动合并最多为0.43分并停留在下方(88.90分),而每个任务移动256个真实图像为1.7至5.0分. 几百个图像上的有监督的信号会进一步减少剩余的出错.

blocks.en: Running the same recipe on ViT-B/16 (600 steps) from other data-free merges, a better start stays ahead but the gap narrows. From a WUDI merge at ridge 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} (88.75; a different setting from Table 1 ) distillation reaches 90.71; from AlphaMerging ( r 1 = 16 r_{1}{=}16 , k = 64 k{=}64 ; 87.11) it reaches 90.31; from unscaled Task Arithmetic (26.54) only 77.98. JNSP ’s 0.70-point lead over the WUDI start shrinks to 0.46 after distillation, so most of the distillation gain does not depend on the initialization, but among the starting points we tried JNSP ends highest.
blocks.zh: 在VIT-B/16上运行同样的配方(600步),从其他没有数据的合并中运行,一个更好的开始会保持领先,但差距会缩小. 从脊3×10−3 3\times 10−3}(88.75;与表1不同的设置)的WUDI合并达到90.71;从AlphaMerging(r 1 = 16 r_{1×16;k = 64 k{=}64; 87.11)达到90.31;从未分级的Arithmetic(26.54)只有77.98。 JNSP在WUDI之上的0.70分领先率在蒸馏后开始收缩到0.46分,因此大部分蒸馏增益并不取决于初始化,而是在我们尝试的JNSP的起始点中收尾最高.

blocks.en: Two things should be kept apart. The first is that our harness is internally consistent: TSV-M, Iso-C and Iso-CTS score within a third of a point on two checkpoint releases produced by different pipelines. The second is that this consistency does not extend to the published values. For TSV-M we do not know why the numbers differ, and we do not assert a cause; the candidate explanation (the authors’ own fine-tuning recipe) is recorded in Section 4.3 as speculation, not as a finding. AlphaMerging’s 89.9 is quoted from its paper; its TALL run, at the best own-checkpoint setting, falls 1.82 points below the same setting on our checkpoint, so for it the checkpoint is not ruled out.
blocks.zh: 应分出二事. 第一,我们的控制装置在内部是一致的:TSV-M、Iso-C和Iso-CTS在由不同管道产生的两个检查站释放量的三分之一内得分。 二是这种一致性不延伸至已公布的数值. 对TSV-M来说,我们不知道数字为何不同,我们没有提出理由;候选解释(作者自己微调的配方)被记录在第4.3节中,作为猜测而不是结论。 AlphaMerging的89.9从报纸上引用, 其TALL在最佳的自我检查点设置下,

blocks.en: Two details are worth noting. First, the joint projection is not uniformly bad on language: on QQP it reaches 49.3, against 21.7 for the global control, although it stays below the 80.4 of the unscaled direct sum; on MRPC, by contrast, it loses 36.7 points to the direct sum (22.3 versus 59.0). Relative to the global control the joint projection loses most on STS-B, MRPC, CoLA and SST-2 (40–98 points) and least on MNLI (10.4); QQP is the only task on which it is higher. We do not test why. Second, the consensus–residual repair changes the pattern: it improves over the global control on CoLA, SST-2, QQP, MNLI, QNLI and RTE, matches it on MRPC (75.7 versus 75.8) and is lower on STS-B (78.1 versus 84.0); on QQP it rises only from 21.7 to 31.5, still far below the joint projection’s 49.3. We have no explanation for QQP’s behaviour and flag it as unresolved.
blocks.zh: 有两个细节值得注意。 首先,联合预测在语言上并一致不好:在QQP上,它达到49.3分,而全球控制则达到21.7分,尽管它仍然低于未分级直接总和的80.4分;相形之下,在MRPC上,它损失了36.7分直接总和(22.3分对59.0分). 相对于全球控制,联合投影在STS-B、MRPC、CoLA和SST-2上损失最多(40-98分),在MNLI上损失最少(10.4);QQP是唯一更高的任务。 我们不测试为什么。 第二,共识-剩余修理改变了模式:它比对CoLA、SST-2、QQP、MNLI、QNLI和RTE的全球控制有所改善,与MRPC(75.7对75.8)相对应,低于STS-B(78.1对84.0);QQP仅从21.7上升到31.5,仍远低于联合预测的49.3。 我们无法解释QQP的行为,

Each residual is filtered as δ ​ 𝝉 ~ i = δ ​ 𝝉 i ​ ( 𝑰 − 𝑸 i ​ 𝑸 i ⊤ ) \tilde{\delta\bm{\tau}}_{i}=\delta\bm{\tau}_{i}(\bm{I}-\bm{Q}_{i}\bm{Q}_{i}^{\top}) , and CR– JNSP merges as 𝜽 = 𝜽 0 + 𝝉 c + ∑ i δ ​ 𝝉 ~ i \bm{\theta}=\bm{\theta}_{0}+\bm{\tau}^{c}+\sum_{i}\tilde{\delta\bm{\tau}}_{i} , with the consensus added once and no merge coefficient. CR– JNSP introduces a second hyperparameter c c , requires a rank sweep to find, and is specific to settings where a large consensus component exists. It improves on the shared-basis control on average (69.45 versus 63.28) but not on every task: it is lower on STS-B (78.1 versus 84.0), and on QQP it rises only from 21.7 to 31.5, still 48.9 points below the unscaled direct sum (80.4). blocks.en: Appendix U Scope, Threats to Validity, and Negative Evidence
blocks.zh: 附录U 范围、对有效性的威胁和消极证据

blocks.en: Section 6 and the Conclusion state the limitations briefly. This appendix expands them and records what we could not establish. We separate three kinds of shortfall: limits on the scope of what was tested, threats to the validity of the conclusions within that scope, and negative results that bound how far the geometric story can be pushed.
blocks.zh: 第6节和结论简要说明了这些限制。 本附录扩充了它们,并记录了我们无法证实的情况。 我们区分了三种缺陷:对试验范围的限制、对该范围内结论有效性的威胁、以及影响几何故事可推动程度的负面结果。

blocks.en: U.1 Scope
blocks.zh: U.1 范围

blocks.en: Every positive result in this paper is image classification with a per-task linear head. The method never merges the heads, so a merged model has no single classifier; evaluating it requires knowing which task an input belongs to, which is the standard protocol in this literature but is also an assumption a deployment would have to satisfy. Nothing in the projection depends on the head being linear, but nothing we measured exercises a head that is not.
blocks.zh: 本文的每个正结果都是以每个任务线性头来进行图像分类. 这个方法从不合并头部,所以一个被合并的模型没有单一的分类器;评价它需要知道一个输入属于哪个任务,这是这个文献中的标准协议,但也是一种必须满足的部署的假设. 投影中没有任何东西取决于头部是线性的,但是我们测量到的不是头部。

blocks.en: All eight experts are CLIP-initialized encoders fine-tuned with cross-entropy on a labelled training set. We did not test contrastive fine-tuning, self-supervised adaptation, LoRA-style low-rank experts, or experts obtained by continued pretraining. This matters for interpretation: one untested reading of our results is that the directions removed in the vision encoder are less essential to other tasks than those removed in the language encoder; Appendix F shows that the vision deltas themselves are substantially shared, not mostly private, and we have not tested whether this reading depends on the supervised cross-entropy objective. The language result of Section 6 suggests the vision behaviour is not universal across objectives and architectures, and we have no controlled experiment isolating which factor is responsible.
blocks.zh: 所有八位专家都是CLIP-初始编码器,在有标签的训练集上对交叉编码进行了微调. 我们没有测试对比性微调、自我监督的适应、LORA式的低级别专家,也没有测试通过持续预训获得的专家。 这对解释很重要:一个未经测试的阅读我们的结果是,在视觉编码器中去掉的方向对于其他任务来说比在语言编码器中去掉的方向不那么重要;附录F显示,视觉三角洲本身在很大程度上是共享的,而不是大多是私有的,我们没有测试这种读取是否依赖于被监督的交叉交替目标. 第6节的语言结果表明,视觉行为在目标和结构上并不普遍,我们没有可控制的实验,孤立哪个因素负责。

blocks.en: The largest model is ViT-L/14 with 101 merged tensors. We did not test models where the merged tensors are numerous enough for the per-tensor SVD cost to dominate—the method is closed-form but not free, and at large scale the O ⁡ ( K ​ N ​ m ​ n 2 ) O(KNmn^{2}) cost may become a practical objection even though it is small at the scales studied here. We also did not test models whose hidden dimension is not rectangular (e.g. factorized attention or mixture-of-experts layers), where the row-space argument of Section 3.2 would need restating.
blocks.zh: 最大的型号为Vit-L/14,有101个合并的百合站. 我们没有测试合并的百分位数足够以每分位数的SVD成本为主的模型——这种方法是封闭式的,但并非免费的,而且大规模地O → (K N m n 2) O(KNmn →% 2)成本可能成为一种实际反对,尽管在本文研究的尺度上它很小. 我们还没有测试其隐藏维度不是长方形的模型(例如,因地制宜的注意或专家混合层),因为第3.2节的行-空格论点需要在此重述。

blocks.en: The merge uses no inputs, labels, or forward passes. It does use the fine-tuned checkpoints themselves, and therefore any information that fine-tuning absorbed from its training data. “Data-free” here means no access to the data at merge time , not that the merge is independent of the data’s influence; a reader who interprets it the stronger way would be overcrediting the method.
blocks.zh: 合并不使用输入、标签或前行通行证。 它确实利用了经过微调的检查站本身,因此从培训数据中吸收了任何微调信息。 这里的“数据免费”是指在合并时无法访问数据,而不是说合并独立于数据的影响;如果读者对合并作出更强有力的解释,那就等于过度肯定了这种方法。

blocks.en: U.2 Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: U.2 对有效性的威胁

blocks.en: The eight experts come from one fine-tuning run each. The two-release comparison in Appendix N substitutes for a seed study, but two releases are not a distribution: they share the same data, the same evaluation splits, and much of the same pipeline. Variance of a point or two would leave the 11.88-point gap to TIES intact, but not the 0.98-point gap to WUDI or the 2.23-point gap to the subspace re-implementations, and would make the 2.94-point joint-versus-shared ablation less secure than it reads. We did not run the fine-tuning sweep that would settle this, and we flag it as the largest unaddressed gap in the evidence.
blocks.zh: 八位专家分别来自一个微调运行. 一项种子研究的附录N替代物中的"双释放"比较,但两种释放不是分布:它们共享相同的数据,相同的评价分裂,以及许多相同的管道. 一个或两个点的相差会使11.88点的空隙完全留给TIES,而不是0.98分的空隙留给WUDI,或者2.23分的空隙留给子空间再执行,并会使2.94分的联想与共享的离想比所读的更不安全. 我们没有进行微调扫荡,以解决这个问题,我们把它称为证据中最大的未解决缺口。

blocks.en: Each dataset is evaluated on the split distributed with the model release. We did not re-split, and we cannot rule out that these splits were used during model selection elsewhere. The baselines share the split and the protocol, so comparisons within Table 1 are matched, but absolute numbers may not transfer to a different split of the same data.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集在模型发布后分配的分数上进行评估. 我们没有重新分割,我们不能排除这些分割被用于其他地方的模型选择。 基线共享分拆和协议,因此表1内的比较是相匹配的,但绝对数可能不会转移到同一数据的不同分拆.

blocks.en: We use r = 16 r{=}16 everywhere, on the basis of the sweep in Appendix E . The plateau is broad—89.30, 89.45, 89.22 at r = 12 , 16 , 20 r{=}12,16,20 —so the choice is not delicate on this task set, but it was still chosen by looking at merged accuracy on the eight tasks, which is the quantity being reported. A genuinely held-out task set would be the clean check, and we did not have one.
blocks.zh: 我们根据附录E中的扫荡情况,在各地使用r=16 r{=}16。 高地范围很广——89.30,89.45,89.22 at r = 12,16,20 r r = 12,16,20——因此这一任务集的选择并不微妙,但还是通过查看八项任务的合并准确性来选择,这就是报告的数量. 真正搁置的任务就是清点,我们没有。

blocks.en: We swept the merge coefficient for every training-free baseline and report each one’s peak, which is generous to them. We did not sweep the baselines’ other hyperparameters exhaustively: TIES density is fixed at 0.2 0.2 and DARE’s drop rate at p = 0.9 p{=}0.9 . A full joint sweep might move a baseline’s peak by a point or two. The margin to the strongest parameter-wise baseline is 11.88 points, so such a change would not affect that ordering; the 0.98-point margin to WUDI’s data-free consensus merge is not secure against a change of that size.
blocks.zh: 我们为每个无训练基线扫清了合并系数,并报告了每个人的峰值,这对他们来说是慷慨的。 我们没有彻底扫清基线的其他超参数: TIES密度被固定为0.2,DARE的下降率为:p = 0.9 p{=}0.9. 完全联合扫荡可能会使基线峰值移动一两点。 最强参数基线的比值为11.88分,因此这种变化不会影响这一顺序;WUDI数据无共识合并的0.98分比值无法抵挡这个大小的改变.

blocks.en: The control projects every task delta against one basis, the top- r r right singular vectors of the summed delta. It matches the joint merge in rank, tensor set, and projection algebra, and differs only in whose subspace is removed. That is the right control for the claim that per-task peer unions matter. It is not a control for the choice of SVD at all: both variants use the same rank- r r right singular basis, so the comparison cannot tell us whether a different low-rank summary—random projections, gradient-based subspaces, or a learned basis—would do better. The ablations in the main text are a comparison within the SVD family.
blocks.zh: 控制对每个任务三角洲进行一个基础的预测,即集合三角洲的上-r右单向量. 它与等分,等分集,和投影代数中的联合合并相匹配,并且只在去除子空间时不同. 这是对每个任务同龄人联盟都很重要的说法的正确控制。 它根本不是SVD的选择控制:两种变体都使用相同的阶次-r正单数基,因此比较无法告诉我们不同的低等简表-随机预测,梯度基子空间,或者一个有学问的基数-是否更好. 主文中的活字是SVD家族内部的比较.

blocks.en: U.3 Negative Evidence
blocks.zh: U.3 负面证据

blocks.en: TIES reaches 90.35 on SVHN and 98.71 on MNIST—within two points of JNSP ; on MNIST the gap is only 0.36, though the paired test still separates them ( p = 7 × 10 − 5 p{=}7\times 10^{-5} , Appendix O ). TIES loses most on GTSRB (24.4), DTD (19.3) and EuroSAT (15.7), and this per-task deficit does not track a task’s mean subspace overlap with the others ( r = − 0.27 r{=}-0.27 across the eight tasks, Figure 7 ). We therefore do not claim that entrywise methods fail where deltas overlap most.
blocks.zh: TIES在SVHN上达到90.35分,在MNIST上达到98.71分,在JNSP的两分之内;在MNIST上,差距只有0.36分,尽管配对测试仍然将它们分开(p=7×10−5 p{=}7\tims 10^{5},附录O)。 TIES在GTSRB(24.4),DTD(19.3)和EuroSAT(15.7)上损失最多,这种每任务赤字无法追踪任务与其它任务的平均子空间重叠(r = - 0.27 r = - 0.27) 图7。 因此,我们并不认为在三角洲最重叠的地方,入门方法会失败。

blocks.en: At r = 32 r{=}32 the joint merge falls to 87.08, below its own r = 12 r{=}12 result, and on RESISC45 at that rank the shared-basis control is ahead by 0.33 points. Projection removes real signal as well as interference, and the method has a failure mode at large rank that we characterize but do not fix. A rank-selection rule that adapts per task—for instance by measuring per-task retained energy and stopping when it drops below a threshold—would be a natural extension; we did not implement one, and the sweep suggests the threshold would be task-dependent.
blocks.zh: 在r = 32 r {=}32时,联合合并降为87.08分,低于它自己的r = 12 r{=}12分的结果,在RESIC45分排名上,共享-基础控制领先0.33分. 投影可以去除真实信号以及干扰,该方法具有一个大等级的故障模式,我们所描述但并不固定. 一项调整每项任务的排序选择规则——例如,通过衡量每个任务保留的能量和在低于门槛时停止——将是一种自然的延伸;我们没有执行这一规则,扫描表明这一门槛取决于任务。

blocks.en: Section 6 reports that the method is worse than the baselines it was meant to improve on for RoBERTa-large. The consensus–residual repair recovers the merge to 69.45, but is still 48.9 points below direct task arithmetic on QQP (31.5 versus 80.4), and its consensus rank c c is itself swept. We report it as a repair, not a contribution, and we do not know whether a decomposition of this kind exists for architectures where no single dominant consensus direction can be found.
blocks.zh: 第6节报告说,该方法比本打算改进的RoBERTa大面积基线更差。 在QQP(31.5对80.4)上, 共识-剩余修补恢复合并到69.45分, 我们把它称为一种修复,而不是一种贡献,我们不知道这种分解是否存在于无法找到单一主导共识方向的建筑中。

blocks.en: The mechanism claim is that the gain comes from removing cross-task interference in input space, not from norm reduction, sparsity, or incidental regularization. Two pieces of evidence support it: the shared-basis control removes a comparable fraction of the delta norm and scores three points lower (Appendix I ); and sequential projection, which also removes overlap but asymmetrically, collapses (Appendix H ). The baselines’ per-task deficit does not track subspace overlap (first paragraph of this subsection), so it is not offered as support. None of these rules out the possibility that some other property correlated with cross-task overlap—for example, that overlapping tasks also have noisier fine-tuning runs—produces the same pattern. A controlled experiment that corrupted one task’s delta with isotropic noise, holding its overlap fixed, would separate these; we did not run it.
blocks.zh: 机制主张是,收益来自消除输入空间的跨任务干扰,而不是从规范的减少,收缩或偶然的规范化. 两块证据支持它:共享-基础控制去除三角洲规范的可比较分数并得分更低三分(附录一;相继投出,也去除重叠但不对称的倒塌(附录H. 基线/任务不足不能跟踪子空间重叠(本分节第一段),因此不作为支持提供。 这些都不排除其他一些与交叉任务重叠相关的财产——例如,重叠的任务也有新手微调——产生相同模式的可能性。 一个用异热带噪音破坏任务三角洲的有控制的实验, 保持其重叠状态, 将它们分开;我们没有运行它。

blocks.en: Appendix V Runtime, Artifacts, and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 附录五 运行时间、工艺和可复制性

blocks.en: The merge computes a thin SVD of each task’s delta for every merged tensor, followed by a QR of the stacked neighbour bases and a projection. On CPU it takes about 61 seconds for the 53 tensors of ViT-B/16 and does not touch a GPU; the corresponding figures for ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 were not measured. Evaluation is the only GPU step. The full comparison in Table 1 therefore requires no training, no fine-tuning, and no data loading during the merge itself.
blocks.zh: 合并后会计算每个任务三角洲的薄 SVD 和每个合并的分数,然后是堆叠相邻基数的QR和投影. 在CPU上,VIT-B/16的53个分数大约需要61秒,并且不接触GPU;VIT-B/32和VIT-L/14的相应数字没有被测量出. 评价是唯一的GPU步骤. 因此,表1中的全面比较不需要培训、调整和在合并过程中不装入数据。

blocks.en: The merged weight files of the ViT-B/16 rank sweep are retained, named by variant and rank ( merged_joint_r8.pt through merged_joint_r32.pt , and merged_global_r8.pt through merged_global_r32.pt ); the sequential file is merged_sequential_r8.pt .
blocks.zh: ViT-B/16分级扫码的合并权重文件被保留下来,按照变体和分级命名(合并_联合_r8.pt通过合并_联合_r32.pt,合并_global_r8.pt通过合并_global_r32.pt;相继文件被合并_序列_r8.pt.

blocks.en: The vision merges take the rank, the variant, and the model and data locations as arguments, write the merged checkpoint, and evaluate it on the eight test splits. The re-implemented subspace baselines of Tables 1 and 2 share one merge-and-evaluate harness with the merge rule as an argument, so they share the evaluator and tensor scope (Appendix C ). The language results use a separate driver.
blocks.zh: 远景合并取等级,变体,模型和数据位置作为参数,写出合并检查站,并按8个测试分数进行评审. 重新执行的表1和表2的子空间基线共享一个并用并用评价的被并用规则作为参数,因此它们共享评价器和热量范围(附录C. 语言结果使用单独的驱动.

blocks.en: The claims of Section 3 are algebraic, so they can be checked against the artifacts rather than argued. We ran four checks on ViT-B/16 at r = 16 r{=}16 , reported in Table 30 .
blocks.zh: 第3节的主张是代数的,所以可以对照文物进行核对,而不是争论. 我们对Vit-B/16进行了四次检查,检查时间为r = 16 r * 16,见表30。

blocks.en: The first block checks that the code reproduces the artifact. Re-running the shared-basis variant from the eight task vectors reproduces the archived merged_global_r16.pt file to 2.8 × 10 − 6 2.8\times 10^{-6} relative error over all 53 tensors, with a worst-tensor absolute deviation of 8.4 × 10 − 6 8.4\times 10^{-6} . The difference is float32 storage rounding in the file, not a discrepancy in the merge; the retained-norm ratio and the wall-clock time reproduce the reported figures exactly.

blocks.en: The second block checks Proposition 3 , and it is worth being precise about what it shows. Permuting the task list changes nothing mathematically— 𝑼 ∪ ( i ) \bm{U}^{(i)}_{\cup} depends on the set of neighbours—but it changes the column order fed to the QR, and therefore the floating-point value of the projector. Across three permutations the merged delta moves by 1.7 1.7 – 1.9 × 10 − 3 1.9\times 10^{-3} relative. The movement is not uniform across tensors. Attention and MLP tensors agree to ≤ 1.3 × 10 − 6 \leq 1.3\times 10^{-6} , while three tensors—the token embedding ( 2.3 × 10 − 2 2.3\times 10^{-2} ), the learned positional embedding ( 1.8 × 10 − 2 1.8\times 10^{-2} ), and the text projection ( 1.6 × 10 − 3 1.6\times 10^{-3} )—carry essentially all of it. Repeating the identical test in float64 drives every one of them below 3.3 × 10 − 11 3.3\times 10^{-11} , which identifies the cause as float32 roundoff rather than an asymmetry in the merge.

blocks.en: The roundoff is amplified in exactly the tensors where the projection is least stable, for two compounding reasons. First, their rank-16 cutoff sits on a near-tied singular value: the ratio s 15 / s 16 s_{15}/s_{16} of the task’s own delta spectrum is 1.003 1.003 for the token embedding and 1.004 1.004 for the text projection, so a rounding-level perturbation of Δ i \Delta_{i} can swap which direction enters 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} . Second, the positional embedding’s eight deltas cancel strongly: the merged delta retains only 0.052 0.052 of the summed norms, so an absolute error of fixed size becomes a large relative error after cancellation. We did not re-evaluate accuracy for each order; the merged deltas differ by at most 1.9 × 10 − 3 1.9\times 10^{-3} in relative terms over all tensors. It does mean that a bitwise-identical merge should not be expected across task orders, and a reader reproducing the numbers should compare accuracies, not weights.
